verses.text: Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh a sihkhit ciangin, Yahweh in Mosheh a huhpa, Nun’ tapa Yahshua kiangah thu a gen inah:
“Ka nasempa Mosheh si ta hi; Israyl mite tungah ka piakna gam ah a pai dingin nang leh hih mite in Yardan a kantan dingin tu mahmahin kithawi in.
Mosheh tungah Ka ciamsa bang teekteekin na khe nuai uh tawh na sikna peuhpeuh uh note kong pia ding hi.
Sehnel gam pan leh Lebanon gam panin gun lianpi Euphrates Gun—Hit mite gam khempeuh dong—leh nitumna lama Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean tuipi, dong nangma gam hi ding hi.
Na nuntak sung tawntung kuamah in na mai hong khak zo lo ding hi. Mosheh ka ompih mah bangin nang kong ompih ding hi. Cikmah hunin nang kong taisan kei ding a, zong kong nusia kei ding hi.
Thahat inla hang in; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in hih mite na makaih ding a, a pu a pate uh tungah piak dingin ka ciamsa gam, hih mite na luahsak ding hi.

Thahat inla hang mahmah in. Ka nasempa Mosheh in nang hong piak Thukham khempeuh limtakin zui-in mangin na sem ding uh hi. Na paina peuhpeuh ah na gualzawh theih nadingin tua Thukham panin taklam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin pial kei un.

Na kamsung uh panun hih Thukham Laibu cikmahin na mangsak peuhmah kei ding uh a, note in tua sunga a kigelhte khempeuh limtakin zui-in na sep theih nadingun a sun a zanin na lung ngaingai ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua ciangin nangma lampi uh in thupha ngah ding a, tua tak ciangin nakpi takin na gualzo ding uh hi.
Nang thu hong piakhin hi lo ka hi hiam? Thahat inla hang in! Lau kei inla lungkia kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh na paina peuhpeuh ah Yahweh note Pa in hong ompih hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yahshua in mite’ uliante thu pia-in a gen inah:

“Giahphual tengah pai unla, mite kiangah, ‘Na lam-an ding uh kigingkhol un; Yahweh na Pa un note hong piakna gam ah a pai ding leh a luah dingin hih ni thum sungin note in hih Yardan na kantan ding uh hi,’ ci-in thu pia un,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Reuben leh Gad, leh Menasheh minam alangte tungah Yahshua in,
“Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in note hong piak thupiakna phawk un; Yahweh na Pa un tawlngakna hong pia-in Yardan nisuahna lampang-a hih gam hong ngahsak ta ding hi.

Yardan nisuahna lampanga Mosheh in note hong piakna gam ah na zite, na tate leh na gankhawite uh a na om ding uh hi; ahih hangin galvan tawh a kithawi galdo ding na mite khempeuh un na sanggamte mai-ah na pai ding uh hi. Na sanggamte uh na huh ding uh hi a,

Yahweh in note tawlngakna hong piak bangin na sanggamte uh zong a piakkhit mateng leh Yahweh na Pa un amaute a piakna gam a luah mateng un na huh ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Yardan nisuahna lampanga nomau neihsa gam ah na ciahkik ding uh a, tua lai ah nuam na sa ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin amaute in Yahshua dawngin a gen inah: kote nong thupiak peuhpeuh, ka hih ding uh a, nong sawlna peuhpeuh ah ka pai ding uh hi.
Na khempeuh ah Mosheh’ thu a vekin ka man bang teekteekun, nangma’ thu a vekin kong mang ding uh hi. Yahweh na Pa in Mosheh a ompih mah bangin nang hong ompih tahen!
Na kammal a lehdo ahih keileh hong nial peuhmah ahi a, na thupiak khempeuh hong mang lo peuhmah kithat ding hi. Thahat inla hang in,” a ci uh hi.

Tua tak ciangin Nun’ tapa Yahshua in Shittim panin thukansim nih simtham takin sawlin, a gen inah, “Pai unla, tua gam leh Yericho va en un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amaute dingkhia uh a, Yericho ah mi nihte tungin, Rachab min nei numei kizuaknu’ inn ah lutin tua lai ah a taam uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin Yericho kumpipa kiangah hih thu kigen hi: Gam sung a kantel ding leh a kansim dingin Israyl mite kiang panin tuni takin hih lai mun ah mi hong tung uh hi, a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yericho kumpipa in Rachab kiangah hih thu zasak hi: Na kiangah hong tung, na inn sunga hong lut mite hong paikhiatpih in; bang hang hiam cihleh gam khempeuh a kantel dingin hong pai uh ahi hi, a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Rachab in tua mite la-in na seel a, amah in kumpipa’ kamtaite tungah, “Hi mah hi, ka kiangah mi hong pai uh hi; ahih hangin amaute koi teng panin hong pai uh hiam cih ka thei kei hi.
Kulhkongpi a kikhak dektak hun ciangin mite a paikhia uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute koi tengah pai uh hiam cih ka thei kei hi. Manlang takin nungdelh un! Na phakha thei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
(Ahih hangin amah in amaute innkhum tungah na paipih to khin a, innkhum tunga a koihsa anthul kung lom nuai-ah a na seelkhin hi.)
Tua ahih manin mite in Yardan’ ngapin a kikantan theihna dong lampi ah a delh uh hi. A delh-te a paikhiatkhit phetin kulh kongpi a kikhak pah hi.
Ahih hangin thukansimte nitak a lum ma-in, innkhum ah tua nu hong paito-in,
amah in amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in hih gam note hong piakkhitna ka thei hi. Note hong kikihtakna kote tungah hong tungkhin ahih manin note hangin hih gam sunga teng khempeuh hansanna kiam semsem hi.

Egypt gam panin na paikhiat lai-un note aa dingin Tuipi San a keusakna leh Yardan nisuahna lampanga om na suksiat maimang uh Amor mite kumpi nihte ahi Sihon leh Og-te tungah na hihna uh ka zakhin uh hi.

Kote in ka zak phetun, ka lungtangte uh tuisuak hi. Note hangin mi khempeuh’ hangsanna bei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh note Pa, Amah pen tunglam vantung leh nuailam leitungah Vanlian Khat ahi hi.
Note tungah hehpihna hong lakkhin ka hih manin ka pa’ inn ah note in hehpihna nong lah nadingun Yahweh’ Min tawh kei tungah hong kiciam un. Tua khit ciangin hih lim a man kei hong pia un.
Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte leh ka sanggam numeite, leh amau tawh a kizom khempeuh, sihna panin kote nong suahtaksak nadingun ka pa’ inn sunga a nungtate hong suaktasak un,” a ci hi.

*Tua tak ciangin mite in amah dawngin, “Kote nuntak ngahna hanga thukkikna pen nang leh na pa’ innkuante aa ding ahi hi. Kote tung leh ka nasepna uh ah nong lehhek kei leh, Yahweh in kote hih gam hong piak ciangin diktakin leh thuman takin kong gamta ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin tua nu in tawlet panin khau khat tawh amaute tuaksuksak hi; bang hang hiam cihleh khuapi khulh sung lampangah ama inn kilam a, khuapikhulh sungah amah teng hi.

Amah in amaute kiangah, “Hong nungdelhte in hong muh loh nadingin mual tung lam manawh un. Hong nungdelhte a ciahkik khit mateng tua lai mun ah ni thum sung kibu un. Tua khit ciangin na pai nading lam uh ah pai pan un,” a ci hi.
Mite in ama kiangah, “Hih ko nong kiciamsak thuciamna a mawkna in ko tung hong tu lo ding a, ka mawh baang kei ding uh hi;

Hih gam sung kong lut uh ciangin hih ko nong tuaksuksakna tawlet ah hih khauhual san ciaptehna limin na khai khol ding a, na nu leh na pa, na sanggam pasalte leh na sanggam numeite, na pa’ innkuanpih khempeuh nangmah ngiat inn sungah na khawm ding hi.

Na inn kongkhak pualam, lampi ah khatpeuh a paikhiat leh, ama sisan ama lutung mah tu ding a; hih kiciamna palsatna hangin a khial ka hi kei ding uh hi. Na inn sunga nang tawh a om khatpeuh tungah ka khut khialh uh leh ama sisan ko lutung mahmah hong tu ding hi.
Ahih keileh nangmah in kote hong lehhekin, ko nasepna mi khatpeuh tungah na gen leh, nang in kote nong kiciamsak kiciamna panin ka peng ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. (Pian 24:8; Matt 27:25; Eze 33:34)

Tua ciangin tua nu in, “Na gen peuhmah uh pen ahi ding bangmah ahi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a pai nading uh ah sawlkhia a, amaute a pai uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in tua tawlet ah khauhual san a khih hi.
Tua lai nusia-in mual tung lamah amaute pai uh a, a nungdelhte a ciahkik mateng ni thum sung tua mun ah a om uh hi. A nungdelhte in lamdung khempeuh ah zong uh a, ahih hangin a mu kei uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin mi nihte kipankik uh hi. Mual tung panin amaute paisuk uh a, gun khat kanin Nun’ tapa Yahshua kiangah a ciahkik uh hi. Amaute tunga thupiangsa khempeuh ama tungah a gen uh hi.
Amaute in Yahshua kiangah, “Yahweh in tua gambup eite khut sungah hong piakhin taktak hi. Eite hangin tua gama a teng mite lung neu mahmah uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zingsangin Yahshua thobaih a, Shittim panin dingkhia-in Yardan nisuahna lam ah a tung hi. Amaute galkah ma-in amah leh Israyl mi khempeuh in tua lai ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Ni thum a cin khit ciangin a uliante uh giahphual khempeuh ah pai uh a,
mite kiangah thu pia-in a gen inah, “Yahweh na Pa uh thuciamna singkuang leh tua a pua Levi siampite na muh uh ciangin, na omna panun dingkhia-in na zui ding uh hi.

Note leh siampite in a puak ding singkuang kikalah cubit 2,000; pi 3,000 kiim, kihalin na om ding uh phawk gige un. A nai ah zong na neh kei ding uh hi. Hih lampi ah pai ngei lo na hih manun a nung na zui ziau lel ding uh a, tua ciangin na pai nading uh na thei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in mite kiangah, “Nomau mah kisiangsak tawmin ki-ap unla, zingcianga dingin kikhop ngeina bangin kigingsa-in om un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note lakah nalamdang bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in siampite kiangah, “Thuciamna singkuang la unla, mite mai-ah galkah un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in thuciamna singkuang la-in mite mai-ah a pai uh hi.
Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Keimah in Mosheh ka ompih bang teekteekin nang kong ompihna Israyl mite in a theih nadingin Israyl mi khempeuh mitmuh-in tuni-in nang tawisan ding kong kipan ding hi.
Singkuang a pua siampite tungah thu na pia ding a, ‘Yardan tuite’ gei na tun uh ciangin, pai-in gun sungah ding gige un,’ na ci ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Israyl mite kiangah, “Hong pai unla, Yahweh na Pa uh kammalte hong za un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Hih thu tawh note lakah a nungta na Pa uh hong omna na thei ding uh hi: Amah in note mai panin lawhsapna om loin Canaan mite, Hit mite, Periz mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, leh Yebus mite hawlkhia ding hi.
En un! Leitung khempeuh a piangsakpa’ thuciamna singkuang note’ mai Yardan sungah a pai hi.
Tu-in Israyl minamte lak pan, minam khat pan mi khatta mi sawm le nih teel un,” a ci hi.
Leitung khempeuh a piangsakpa ahi Yahweh’ singkuang a pua siampite in Yardan tuite ah a khe a ngak phetun, tui a luangsuk kimlai kikhenin, suangcian bangin a dingto hi.
Yardan kantan dingin mite in giahphual phel uh a, amaute mai-ah thuciamna singkuang a pua siampite ma pai uh hi.
Yardan ah singkuang a puate tung uh a, tui nawl ah singkuang a pua siampite in a khe uh a ngak ciangin, (Bang hang hiam cihleh anlak hun sung buppi-in Yardan a piau khempeuh let hi),

tui a khang kim lai khawl hi. A lompi-in kiciangto venvan-a gamla pipek, Zaretan gei-a Adam kici khuapi dong vungto-in, a nuaisiah-a luangsukte Ci Tuipi ahi Arabah Tuipi; Tuipi Si, dongah a kikhentat siang kiuhkeuh hi. Tua ahih manin mite in Yericho gal ah a galkah uh hi.
Israyl mi khempeuh in leikeu tung tawnin, minam buppi in Yardan a kantan khit mateng Yardan gun laizang leikeu tungah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a pua siampite a dingkip uh hi.
Minam buppi in Yardan a kantan khit uh ciangin, Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah:
“Minam khat panin khatta, mite kiang panin mi sawm le nih teel inla,
amaute kiangah, ‘Yardan laizang, siampite a dinkipna mun panin suangtum sawm le nih la-in pua unla, tuzanin giahphual na satna ding mun ah tuate phut un,’ ci-in thu pia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in minam khat panin khatta, Israyl mite lak panin ama sehsa mi sawm le nihte samkhawm a,
amaute kiangah, “Yahweh na Pa’ singkuang mai, Yardan laizang ah va pai un. Israyl minam phazah tawh kizui-in note in suangtum khat ciat la-in na liangko tung uh ah pua un.
Tua hileh note lakah ciaptehna khat bang hi ding hi. Mailam hun ah na tate un, ‘Hih suangte bang a deihna ahi hiam?’ ci-in hong dot uh ciangin,

amaute kiangah, ‘Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang in Yardan a kantan ciangin a mai panin Yardan tuite kikhen hi,’ ci-in na gencian ding uh hi. Hih bang danin Israyl mite aa dingin hih suangtumte pen phawk tawntungna khat hi ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua a thupiak bang linlianin Israyl mite in sem uh hi. Israyl minam phazah tawh kizui-in Yahweh in Yahshua a hilhsa bangin amaute in Yardan laizang panin suangtum sawm le nih domto-in giahphual a satna mun ah pua uh a, tua lai mun ah a koih uh hi.
Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a pua siampite khe a ngakna mun, Yardan laizang ah zong Nun’ tapa Yahshua in suangtum sawm le nih a phut hi. Tuate pen tuni mahmah dongin tua lai mun ah omlai hi.
Yahweh in Yahshua a thupiaksa khempeuh mite in a sep khit matengin Yardan laizang ah singkuang a pua siampite ding tansuak uh a, tua ciangin mite kinawhin, a galkah uh hi.
Mi khempeuh a galkah gaihkhit uh ciangin Yahweh’ singkuang leh singkuang a pua siampite zong mite omna ah a galkah uh hi.
Mosheh in amaute a hilhsa bangin Israyl mite mai-ah Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Menasheh minam alangte in galhiam tawisa-in galkah uh hi.
Galdo dingin galvan tawh a kithawi mi 40,000 bang Yahweh mai-ah galsim dingin Yericho leitamzang ah a pai uh hi.
Tua ni-in Yahweh in Israyl khempeuh muhna ah Yahshua tawisang hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Mosheh a zahtak bang teekteekun a nuntak sung tawntung amah zahtak uh hi.
Yahweh in Yahshua hopihin a gen inah:
“Tecipanna singkuang a pua siampite, Yardan panin a paitoh nadingun thupia in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua in siampite thupia a, “Yardan panin hong paito un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang pua-in gun sung panin siampite hong paito uh hi. A khete un leikeu a sukkhak phetin Yardan tuite amau mun ah luangkik a, a ngeina bangin a piau khempeuh tuumin a luang hi.
Kha masa, a ni Sawm Ni-in Yardan panin mite paikhia uh a, Yericho nisuahna gamgi, Gilgal ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Yardan panin a lak uh tua suangtum sawm le nihte, Yahshua in Gilgal ah a phut hi.
Yahshua in Israyl mite kiangah, “Mailam hun ah na tate un, ‘Hih suangtumte bang a deihna ahi hiam?’ ci-in a pate kiangah a dot uh ciangin,
na tate uh kiangah, ‘Israyl-te in leikeu tungah hih Yardan kantan uh hi,’ ci-in na hilh ding uh hi;

Bang hang hiam cihleh note in Tuipi San na kantankhit matengun Yahweh in note mai-ah a kansak Tuipi San tungah a bawl teekteekin note na galkah khit matengun na mai uh ah Yahweh in Yardan tuite a kangsak hi.
Yahweh’ khut in vanglian hi, ci-in a theih nading leh Yahweh na Pa uh a tawntungin na zahtak theih nadingun hih bangin a hih ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Yardan nitumna lama om Amor mite’ kumpite khempeuh leh tuipi dunga om Canaan mite’ kumpite khempeuh in Israyl mite a galkah khit mateng Israyl mite mai panin Yahweh in Yardan tuite a kansak na thu a zak uh ciangin a lungtang uh tuisuakin, Israyl mite maituah ngam nadingin hangsanna them zong a nei nawn kei uh hi.
Tua hunin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Meisuang temte bawl inla, Israyl’ tapate vun-atkik in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua in meisuang temte bawl a, Gibeah Haaraloth ah Israyl’ tapate’ vun a at hi.
Egypt gam panin a paikhia pasal gal do mi khempeuh, Egypt a nusiata kipan sehnel gam lam tawntung ah sikhin uh ahih manin Yahshua in hih bangin amaute vun a at ahi hi.
Egypt panin a paikhia pasal khempeuh vun ki-atsa hi a, ahih hangin a paikhiat khit sehnel gam lamkala a suak pasal khempeuh vun ki-at nai lo hi.

Yahweh’ thu a man lohna uh hangin Egypt panin a paikhia gal mi khempeuh a sihkhit mateng, sehnel gam ah kum 40 sung Israyl mite a pai kawikawi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a pu a pate uh tungah piak dingin a ciamsa, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luanna gam a muh khak loh nadingun amaute tungah Yahweh kiciamkhin hi.
Ahih hangin amaute tangin Yahweh in a dinsak a tate in mu ding uh hi. Tuate pen Yahshua in vun a atte ahi hi. Lam tawntung ah amaute a vun uh ki-at ngei nai lo ahih manin vun-at nai lohin a om uh hi.
Amaute in minam khempeuh vun-atna a mankhit uh ciangin, a damkik matengun giahphual ah a om uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Tuni-in note kiang panin Egypt a minsiatna ka zialmangkhin hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin tuni dongin tua mun pen Gilgal kici hi. A khiatna pen Zial ahih keileh Beem a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl mite in Gilgal ah giahphual sat uh a, Yericho leitamzang ah a Kha Masa, ni sawm le li ni, nitak nih kikalin Paisan biakna a pia uh hi. (Siam 23:5)
Paisan tuuno a kipiak khit a zingciangin amaute in tua gam pana piangte ne uh hi—tua ni teekteek mahin silngo sawh loh anlum leh a kihangmin an ne uh hi.
Amaute in tua gama piangte a nekkhit uh a zingciangin manna bei ta hi. Israyl mite aa dingin manna om nawn lo hi. Amaute in tua kumin Canaan gama piangte a ne uh hi.

Yericho nai-ah Yahshua a tun ciangin, a ettoh leh a mai-ah namsau dawhsa tawi-in a ding mi khat a mu hi. Yahshua zong mipa lamah pai-in ama kiangah, “Nang ko pawl maw, ka galte uh pawl?” ci-in a dong hi.

Amah in, “Kuamah pawl hi lo! Yahweh’ galkap ukpa-in tu-in a hong tung ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahshua in zahtak piakna-in leilak lamah mai kunsukin, “Na nasempa tungah bang thu hong kipiakhin ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Yahweh’ galkap ukpa in Yahshua kiangah, “Na dinna mun siangtho ahih manin, na khe panin na khedapte suah in,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin Yahshua a gamta hi.
Israyl mite hangin Yericho khauh takin a kikhakcip hi. Kuamah pusuak loin kuamah sungtum lo hi.
Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “En in! Yericho, a kumpipa leh a galdo mite na khut sungah kong piakhin hi.
Khuapi kiimkotah na galdo mite khempeuh khatvei na kiimkot ding uh hi. Tua bangin ni guk sung na pai ding uh hi.

Singkuang mai-ah tuutal ki; peengkul, a tawi siampi sagih paisak in. A ni sagihna ni-in siampite in tuutalki-peengkul; teki’ah; a ki-awisuak, a aw tat loin, mutin sagihvei khuapi na kiimkot ding uh hi.

Siampite in tuutal’ ki sauveipi a ginsakin tuutal peengkul ging na zak uh ciangin, mi khempeuh nakpitakin awng ding uh hi; tua ciangin khuapi kulh kicim nen ding hi. Mi khempeuh a mai-ah tangtakin paito ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Nun’ tapa Yahshua in siampite samin amaute kiangah, “Thuciamna singkuang la unla, Yahweh’ singkuang mai-ah siampi sagih in tuutalki-peengkul sagih tawisak un,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, “Mipite kiangah: Dingkhia un! Yahweh’ singkuang mai-ah galhiam tawi mite omsak unla, khuapi kiimkot un, ci-in thupia un,” a ci hi.
Yahshua in thu a genkhit ciangin, Yahweh mai-ah tuutalki-peengkul sagih a tawi siampi sagihte mainawtin tuutalki-peengkul tum mut uh a, Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang in amaute a zui hi.
Tuutalki-peengkul a mut siampite mai-ah galhiam tawi mite pai uh a, a nung a cingte in singkuang zui uh hi. Hih hun sung khempeuh tuutalki-peengkul; teki’ah; saupi awi-in, a kimut den hi.

Tu-in Yahshua in mite thupia-in, “Note na awng nawn kei ding uh a, na aw uh zong na kizasak kei ding uh hi. Awng un!, ci-in thu kong piak ni matengin na kam panun kammal khat zong gingkhia lo ding hi. Awng un ka cih ciang bekin na vekpi un na awng ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Yahweh’ singkuang khuapi khatvei kiimkotsak hi. Tua khit ciangin giahphual ah mite ciahin, tua lai ah a zangiak uh hi.
Zingsangin Yahshua thobaihin, siampite in Yahweh’ singkuang a pua uh hi.

Tuutalki-peengkul a pua siampi sagihte in saupi awi-in a mut kawmin Yahweh’ singkuang mai-ah a mainawt uh hi. Amau’ mai-ah galhiam tawi mite pai uh a, peengkulte a kitum suaksuak laitakin Yahweh’ singkuang nungah a nung a cingte a pai hi.
A ni nihna ni-in amaute in khuapi khatvei kiimkot uh a, tua khit ciangin giahphual ah a ciah uh hi. Ni guk sung tua bangin amaute in a hih uh hi.
A hih hangin a ni sagihna ni-in amaute khuavak lianin tho uh a, tua ni sagih vei a kiimkot uh cih simloh nidanga mah bangin khuapi kiimkot ah sagihvei a pai uh hi.
A vial sagihna ah siampite in peengkul a mut ciangin, Yahshua in mite kiangah, “Awng un! Yahweh in khuapi no tungah hong piakhin hi!

Khuapi leh a sunga om a nungta na khempeuh suksiat dingin ki-ap ding hi. Numei paktat Rachab leh a inn sunga amah tawh a om khempeuh bek nungta ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in eite sawl thukansimte na seelsak a, amaute lehhek lo hi.

Ahih hangin a ki-apsa nate la kei un; tua bangin ahih keileh note zong tuate lakna hangin suksiat dingin a ki-apte na suak ding uh hi. A ki-apsa na khatpeuh na lak uh leh, Israyl giahphual siattutin, a tungah haksat buaina na tunkha ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ngun leh kham, sumngo leh sik vanzatte khempeuh Yahweh aa dingin sehtuam ahi hi. Tuate pen Yahweh’ van manpha lakah kitun pelmawh ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin tuutalki-peengkul a ging ciangin mite awng uh hi. Mite in tuutalki-peengkul awging a zak uh ciangin nakpitakin awng uh a, kulhpi a kicim hi. Tua ciangin mite khuapi sung amau’ mai ciat ah tangtakin paito uh a, khuapi a la uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh tungah khuapi ap uh a, a sunga om nuntakna a nei peuhmah—numei, pasal, a moi, a ham, bawnghon khempeuh, tuuhon khempeuh, laate khempeuh namsau hiam tawh a susia uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahshua in gam van mi nihte kiangah, “A paktatnu’ inn sungah lut unla, numei leh ama neih khempeuh hong paikhiatpih unla, na hih ding uh hi, ci-in na kiciamna mah bangin amah nungtasak un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin thukansim khangno tegel va tumin Rachab, a nu, a pa, a sanggam pasalte, a sanggam numeite, leh a neih khempeuh a paikhiatpih uh hi. Amaute in tuanu tanau teng khempeuh paikhiatpihin Israyl-te’ giahphual pualam ah a koih uh a,
tua khit ciangin tua khuapi leh a sunga om khempeuh mei tawh a hal uh hi. Ngun leh kham, sumngo leh sik vanzat bek Yahweh’ Inn van manpha lakah a koih uh hi.

Yahshua in a paktat Rachab, a pa’ innsungmite leh tua nu’ neih khempeuh a hawi hi. Tuni dongin Israyl mite lakah tua nu teng hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahshua in Yericho a kantel dingin a sawl kamtaite amah in selin, amaute a lehhek kei hi.

Tua hun lai-in Yahshua in hih a thupi kiciamna genkhia a, “Yericho khuapi, a lamkik dinga a kipan mipa in Yahweh mai-ah samsiatna ngah tahen. A tacil luang khaamin a bulpi phut ding a, a ta neupen luang khaamin kulhkongpite dingsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bangin Yahweh in Yahshua ompih a, ama’ minliatna gam khempeuh ah a kizel hi.

Ahih hangin Israyl mite in a ki-apsa nate ah khialhna a gamta uh hi. Yahdah minam panin Zerah’ tapa ahi Zimri, Zimri’ tapa Carmi, Carmi’ tapa Achan in tuate pawlkhat a na la hi. Tua ciangin Israyl mite tungah Yahweh’ hehna a kuang hi.
Yahshua in Beth-El nisuahna lampanga om Ai ah mi pawlkhat sawl a, “Pai to unla, tua gam kuam teng va kansim un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin mite paito-in, Ai a va kansim uh hi.

Yahshua kiangah a ciahkik uh ciangin, amaute in, “Mi tul nih, tul thum khawng paito-in Ai simin zo ding i hih manin mite a vekin sawl kei in. Tua lai mun ah mi tawmno bek om ahih manin mite a vekin gimsak kei in,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin mi tul thum kiim bek paito uh a, ahih hangin Ai mite in na delhkek uh hi.
Ai mite in kulhkongpi panin Shebarim ciang dong delh uh a, tuahsukna mun ah mi 36 a that uh hi. Hih thu hangin mite’ lungsim bei-in tuisik a bang hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in a puante balkekin, Yahweh’ singkuang mai, a lu tungah leivui koihin nitak matengin, leilak lamah a mai kunsuk hi. Israyl upate zong tua bang mah ahi uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Alaa! Pa Yahweh, Yardan gal ah bang hangin hih mite hong paipih na hi hiam? Kote hong susia dingin Amor mite’ khut sungah kote hong pia ding na hi hiam? Yardan pang langkhat lamah a teng dingin a lungkim hizaw tahoh le-ung maw!
Yahweh aw, tu-in Israyl-te, a galte delhkeksa-in om a, bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi hiam?
Canaan mite leh hih gam a mi dangte in hih thu za ding uh a, amaute in hong umcih-in leitung panin ka minte uh hong phiatkhia ding uh hi. A lian mahmah Na Min bang lawh ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Tho in! Bang hangin kupbawh na hi hiam?
Israyl-te mawhkhin hi! Amaute’ zuih dinga ka thupiak palsatkhin uh hi. Amaute in a ki-ap nate pawlkhat lakhin uh hi. Amaute in gu-in a guta imcip uh hi; amaute’ neihsa lakah tuate koih uh hi.

Hih thu hangin Israyl mite in a galte a nangzo kei uh hi. A galte mai panin amaute lehtai uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau mahmah zong a ki-apsa a suak uh hi. Note lakah suksiat dingin a ki-ap peuhpeuh na suksiat kei uh leh, note kong ompih nawn kei ding hi.

Tho inla, biakna ngeina bangin a kiging nadingun amaute kiangah, ‘Zingcianga dingin kisiansuah unla kisehtuam un; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in, ‘Israyl aw, note lakah a ki-apsa na om hi. Note lak panin a ki-ap nate na hepkhiat matengun na galte na nangzo kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi,’ ci-in gen in.

Zingsangin a minam nam-in na sam ding hi. Yahweh in a lak minam panin a behbehin hong neh ding uh hi. Yahweh in a lak beh sung panin a innkuankuanin hong neh ding uh hi. Yahweh in a lak innkuan sung panin a mi malmalin a madawkkhia ding uh hi.
A ki-ap nate tawh a kiman khawmpa, amah tawh a kizom a neih khempeuh mei tawh kisusia ding hi. Amah in Yahweh’ thuciamna palsatkhin a, Israyl sungah tatsiatna a gamta hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a zingsang ciangin Yahshua thobaih a, Israyl-te a minam nam-in a sam hi. Yahdah minam pen lim sittel dingin a kila hi.
Tua ciangin Yahdah behte hong madawkkhia uh a, Zerah mite’ beh kila hi. Amah in Zerah mite’ beh a innkuankuanin madawkkhiasak a, Zimri innkuan kila hi.
Yahshua in Zimri innkuan a mi malmalin madawkkhiasak a, Yahdah minam pan Zerah’ tapa Zimri, Zimri’ tapa Carmi, Carmi’ tapa Achan a kila hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua in Achan kiangah, “Ka ta aw, Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh minthangsak inla, Ama tungah phatna pia in. Ama tungah kipulaak inla, na gamtatsa peuhpeuh kei hong gen in. Bangmah hong im kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Achan in Yahshua dawng a, “A taktakin, Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh tungah a mawhkhin a, ka gamtatna hih bang ahi hi:

Shinar; Babylon, panin puantualpi hoih khat, ngun shekel 200 leh shekel 50 a gik kham tawn khat ka muh ciangin tuate iplah lua ka hih manin ka la hi. Tu-in ka puanbuk sunglam lei sungah tuate leh a nuai ah ngun tawh ka seel hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua in mi sawl a, tua puanbuk ah amaute va tai uh hi. a puanbuk sungah a ngun nuainungin na kiselin tua lai ah na om hi.
Puanbuk sung panin amaute in tua a ki-apsa nate la uh a, Yahshua leh Israyl mite kiangah paipihin, Yahweh mai-ah a phalh uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh in Zerah’ tapa Achan, a ngun, a puantualpi, a kham tawn, a zi, a tapate, a tanute, a bawngtalte, a laate, a tuute, a puanbuk leh ama neih khempeuh la uh a, Achor Kuam; Siatgawpsakna Kuam, ah a paipih uh hi.

Yahshua in, “Bang hangin kote hong siagawpsak na hi hiam? Tuni mahmahin Yahweh in hong siagawpsak ding hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israyl khempeuh in suangtumte tawh denglum uh a, a denlupkhit uh ciangin, amaute a hal uh hi.

Achan tungah amaute in suangtum honkhat ciang venvan uh a, tuni dongin tua lai mun ah om lai hi. Hih bang danin Yahweh in a hehluatna a daisak hi. Tua mun min pen tuni dongin Achor Kuam; Siatgawpsakna Kuam, kici hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Lau kei in. Lungkia kei in. Nang tawh galmi khempeuh sam inla Ai ah paikik in. En in, Ai kumpipa, a mite, a khuapi leh a gam na khut sungah kong piakhin hi.

Yericho leh a kumpipa tungah na bawl bang teekteekin Ai leh a kumpipa tungah na bawl ding hi. Tu-a ah, note aa dingin a vante leh a gankhawite no aa dingin na la thei ding uh hi. Khuapi nungah a buksimte na pangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua leh galmi khempeuh Ai ah a pai dingin a dingto uh hi. Yahshua in a galsiampen mi 30,000 teelin, zanin amaute a sawlkhia hi.
Amah in hih thute a pia hi: “Note in khuapi nungah na buksim ding uh hi. Tua panin gamlapi na pai kei ding uh a, na vekun pilvangsa leh kigingsa-in na om un;
Kei leh kei tawh a om mi khempeuh in khuapi ka naih ding uh hi. A masa-a a hih bangun kote hong do dingin hong kuankhiat uh ciangin amaute’ kiang panin ka na tai ding uh hi.

Khuapi panin amaute hong paikhiatkhit matengin kote hong delh ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in, ‘A masa-a bangin eite’ mai-ah amaute tai uh hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun ding uh hi. Amaute mai panin ka tai uh ciangin,
na buksim na uh panin na kipan ding uh a, khuapi na la ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh note Pa in na khut sung uh ah hong pia ding hi.
Khuapi na lakkhit uh ciangin, mei-in na hal ding uh ahi hi. Yahweh’ Thukham tawh kizui-in na hih ding uh hi. Thu kong piakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute sawlkhia hi. A buksim na ding mun ah amaute tung uh a, Beth-El leh Ai kilak, Ai nitumna lamah ngak uh a, ahih hangin Yahshua pen giahphual-a mite lakah a omlai hi.
Zingsangin Yahshua thobaihin mite a kaikhawm hi. Amah leh Israyl upate Ai lam zuanin mite mai-ah a pai uh hi.
Amah tawh a om galsim mi khempeuh khuapi gal a tun matengun paito uh hi. Ai nitumna lamah giahphual sat uh a, amaute leh khuapi kikal ah kuam khat om hi.
Yahshua in mi 5,000 kiim sehin, Bethel leh Ai kikal, nitumna lamah a buksim dingin a koih hi.
Galsim mite, khuapi leilu lamah a phualpi leh khuapi nitumna lamah a buksimte a koih uh hi. Tua zanin kuam sungah Yahshua a pai hi.

Ai kumpipa in hih banga kihih a muh ciangin, amah leh khuapi-a mite khempeuh Israyl-te a do dingin nawhtakin a kithawi uh hi. Amah leh a mite khempeuh Arabah tawh a kimai-ngat a kisehna mun khat ah a om uh hi; ahih hangin amah in khuapi nunglam ah amah langah a buksimte a om lam a thei kei hi.
Amaute mai-ah Yahshua leh Israyl khempeuh kilel tawmsak uh a, gamlak lamah a tai uh hi.
Ai mi khempeuh amaute a nungdelh dingin a kisam uh hi. Amaute in Yahshua nungdelh a, khuapi panin a kihemkhia ahi hi.
Ai ah ahi a, Bethel ah ahi zongin Israylte a nungdelh loin a omlai pasal khat zong a om kei hi. Israyl-te a delh sungin amaute in khuapi uh hong dedasa-in a nusia uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Na khuta na namsau Ai lamah ngat in; bang hang hiam cihleh na vangliatna sungah tua khua kong pia ding hi.,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahshua in a khuta namsau khuapi lam a ngat hi.
Yahshua in a namsau a ngat phetin a buksim mite a omna uh panin manlang takin dingkhia pah uh a, a mainawt henhan uh hi. Khuapi sungah lutin khuapi la uh a, tua khuapi mei tawh a hal pah uh hi.

Ai mite in a nunglam uh a et uh ciangin, a khuapi uh kangin meikhu kahto a mu uh hi. Gamlak lama a tai Israyl’ galsim mite amaute lamah a kiheikik ciangin amaute a nung ahi a, a mai lam ahi zongin koimah ah tai thei lo uh hi.
A buksimte in khuapi a lakkhitna uh leh tua khuapi panin meikhu a kahtohna Yahshua leh Israyl khempeuh in a muh ciangin, amaute kiheikikin Ai mite a vatgawp uh hi.

A buksim mite zong amau langah khuapi panin hong kuankhia uh ahih manin Israyl galsim mite’ umcihsa-in a laizang ah a kiman uh hi. Israyl mite in amaute vatmai hi. Amaute nungta ahi a, a suakta ahi zongin khatbeek omsak lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Ai kumpipa hingmatin, Yahshua kiangah a paipih uh hi.
Israyl-te in amaute a delhna lolai ah ahi a, gamlak ah ahi zongin Ai mi khempeuh a thatkhit uh ciangin Israyl galsim mi khempeuh Ai ah hong paikikin a sunga omte a that uh hi.
Tua ni-in a kithat Ai mi khempeuh numei hitaleh pasal hitaleh mi 12,000 a pha hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Ai sunga a teng khempeuh a suksiatkhit matengin Yahshua in a namsau a tawina khut a dokkik kei hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh in Yahshua a hilhsa bangin Israyl-te in hih khuapi-a a gankhawite leh a vante amau aa dingin a la uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua in Ai khua halin tuni dong vansia kholna suakin a kisiacip a suaksak hi.

Tua ciangin Ai kumpipa nitak matengin singkung khat tungah a kikhai hi. Ni a tumsuk phetin sing tung panin a luang a kilakkhiat nadingin Yahshua in amaute thupia a, khuapi lutna kulhkongpi ah a luang pai-in, a tungah suangtum tampi ciang uh a, tuni dongin a omlai hi.
Yahshua in Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh aa dingin Ebal Mual tungah biaknatau khat lam a,

Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh in Israyl mite tungah sep dingin a thupiak bangin leh Mosheh’ Thukham Laibu sunga a kigelh bangin sik nazat khatpeuh a kitah lo, a kiseek lo suangtumte tawh biaknatau khat a bawl hi. A tungah Yahweh aa dingin meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia uh hi.
Tua lai mun, Israyl mite omna ah, Israyl-te aa dingin Mosheh in a gelhsa Thukham a kibangin amah in suangte tungah a gelh hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl khempeuh, peemta hitaleh amaute’ laka a suakte hitaleh, a upate uh hitaleh, a uliante uh hitaleh, thukhente hitaleh Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang langtuak ah ding uh a, singkuang a pua Levi mi siampite a maingat uh hi. Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh in, Israyl mite thupha a kipiak ciangin hih dinga lamlahna a piaksa bangin mipi alang pen Gerizim Mual mai-ah ding uh a, adang alangte pen Ebal Mual tungah a ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Thukham Laibu sunga a kigelh bangin Yahshua in Thukham kammalte khempeuh—thuphate leh samsiatnate—a sim hi.
Numei leh naupang, leh amaute’ laka a peem khualmite zong a kihel Israyl mihon buppi tungah Yahshua in Mosheh thupiaksa khempeuh a simkhiat loh kammal khatbeek a om kei hi.

Yardan hih lampanga om mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Lebanon lam Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean tuipi, dung khempeuha om kumpite khempeuh, Hit mite, Amor mite, Canaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, leh Yebus mite in hih nate a zak uh ciangin,
Yahshua leh Israyl a do dingin lungsim kikhatin a kikaikhawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in Yericho leh Ai tungah a bawlna thu Gibeon-a teng mite in a zak uh ciangin,
amaute in khembawl sawm uh a, amaute taangmi-a pai a kineihkhem uh hi. A laate uh ippi paatsa, a kitamsa a kithuap savun-um luite a suan uh hi.
Amaute in a puan luite uh silhin a kiphop a khedap luite a bulh uh hi. A lam-an dingun a puak uh anlum khempeuh keu-in a ap hi.
Tua ciangin Gilgal-a giahphual a sat Yahshua kiangah amaute pai uh a, amah leh Israyl mite kiangah, “Kote tawh thuciamna nong bawl theih nadingun gamla-pi panin hong pai ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl mite in Hiv mite kiangah, “Ahih hangin kote mai-a teng mite na hikha thei ding uh hi. Bangci bangin note tawh thuciamna hong bawl thei ding i hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in Yahshua kiangah, “Na nasemte kong hi ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “No kuate hi a, koi panin hong pai na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Yahweh na Pa uh minliatna hangin a gamla mahmah gam panin na nasemte hong pai ka hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama thu a kipuaknate leh Egypt gam ah a bawlte khempeuh,
Yardan gal a Amor mite’ kumpite ahi Heshbon kumpi Sihon leh Ashtaroth a uk Bashan kumpi Og-te tungah a hihna khempeuh ka zakhin uh hi.

Tua ahih manin ka upate uh leh ka gam mite khempeuh un kote kiangah, ‘Na khualzin nading uh lam-an bawl unla, va kimu unla, amaute kiangah, ‘Na nasemte ka hi uh hi. Tu-in ko tawh thuciamna bawl ni,’ va ci un,’ hong ci uh hi.
No kiangah hong zin dingin ka inn panun kong dinkhia-in an ka tuun lai-un hih anlumte lum lai hi. Ahi zongin tu-in en in, keu-in ap hi.
Hih leenggahzu-umte ka dip lai-un a thak hi a, ahih hangin tu-in en in, puakgawpta hi. Ka puante leh ka khedapte uh khual gamlapi zinna-in paatgawpta hi,” a ci uh hi.
Israyl mite in amau’ lam-ante kimkhat la uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh’ khensatna dong lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute a hin khawi nadingin kilemna thuciam bawlin mihonpite makaite tawh kiciamna a kipsak hi.

Tua ciangin Israyl mite dingkhia uh a, a ni thum ni-in a khuapite uh ahi: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth, leh Kiryath Yearim a tung uh hi.

Ahih hangin Israyl mite in amaute do lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh konlawhin amaute tungah Israyl’ mihon makaite kiciamkhin uh hi. Tua ciangin mihonte khempeuh upate a phunsan uh hi.
Tua ciangin makaite khempeuh in mihon khempeuh kiangah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh konlawhin amaute tungah ka kiciamkhin uh a, tu-in amaute i su thei kei hi.
Ahih hangin amaute tungah i hici hih ding hi: Amaute tungah i kiciamna palsatna hangin eite tungah hehna hong tung loh nadingin amaute nungtasak ni” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in a thugen zomto lai-in, “Amaute nungtasak ni, ahi zongin upate in amaute a ciamsa bangin i mi buppi singtom leh tui tawi-in zang ni,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Gibeon mite samin amaute kiangah, “Bang hangin ko kianga teng hi napi, ‘No kiang pan gamlapi ah ka teng uh hi,’ ci-in hong khem na hi uh hiam?
Tu-in samsiatna nuai-ah na om uh hi. Ka Pa, Yahweh’ Inn aa dingin singtom leh tui tawi semin, sila hihna panin cikmahin na suakta ngei kei ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Amaute in Yahshua kiangah, “Yahweh’ na Pa in Ama nasem Mosheh tungah gam khempeuh nang hong pia-in a tengsa mi khempeuh na mai panin a suksiat maimang nading thu a piakna ko na nasemte tungah siangtakin hong kigen hi. Note hangin ka nuntak nadingun lau lua mahmah ka hih manin hih bangin a hih ka hi uh hi.
Hoih hi! Nangma hatna sungah ka om uh hi. Nang aa dingin a man leh hoih nasak bangin kote tungah hong bawl in,” a ci uh hi.
Yahshua in tua bangin a hih hi. Amah in Israyl mite’ khut panin amaute honkhia-in, amaute a that kei uh hi.
Tua ni-in Yahshua in mihonte aa ding, Yahweh in a teelna ding mun-a Yahweh’ biaknatau aa dingin singtom leh tui tawi-in bawl ahih manin tuni nangawn dongin amaute a omlai uh hi.

Yahshua in Ai la-in susia maimang a, Yericho leh a kumpipa tungah a bawl bangin Ai leh a kumpipa tungah a bawlna leh Gibeon mite in Israyl-te tawh kilemna thuciam bawlin amau’ nai-ah a tenna thu Yerusalem kumpipa Adoni-Zedek in a zak ciangin,
amaute nak lau mahmah uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Gibeon pen kumpi khuapite mah bangin khuapi thupi khat ahi hi. Tua pen Ai sangin lianzaw a, a mite khempeuh galsiam mite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Yerusalem kumpipa Adoni-Zedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Yarmuth kumpipa Piram, Lachish kumpipa Yaphia leh Eglon kumpipa Debir-te kiangah mi sawlin, amaute kiangah:
“Hong paito unla, Gibeon hong dopih un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahshua leh Israyl mite tawh kilemna a bawlkhin uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin hih nitumna lam kumpi ngate ahi: Yerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Yarmuth kumpipa, Lachish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa-te in a pawlpih uh hi. Amaute, a galkapte khempeuh uh tawh paito uh a, Gibeon langah panmun la-in a sim uh hi.

Tua ciangin Gibeon mite in Gilgal-a giahphual a sat Yahshua kiangah mi sawl uh a, “Na nasemte hong nusia kei in. Kote kiangah manlang takin hong paito inla, hong hon in! Kote hong huh in, bang hang hiam cihleh mualtung gam panin hih nitumna lam kumpite a galtha uh gawmin kote hong langdo uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gilgal panin Yahshua leh a galmite khempeuh, a galsiam pente zong tawh a paito hi.
Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Amaute kihta kei in. Na hatna sungah amaute kong piakhin a, tua lai-a mite khat beek in nang hong nangzo lo ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Gilgal panin zan tawntung a pai khit uh ciangin Yahshua in theihkholh lohin amaute a simgawp hi.

Tua ahih manin Gibeon ah amaute tampitak thatin a zo Israyl-te mai-ah Yahweh in amaute amkhamsak hi. Israyl-te in Beth Horon paina lampi tawntung ah amaute delhin, Azekah leh Makkedah ciang dong amaute a vatgawp uh hi.

Beth Horon panin Azekah a paisuk lampi ah, Israyl-te mai-a a tai laitakun, vantung panin amaute tungah Yahweh in gial lianpi tawh dengsukin, a si uh hi. Israyl-te in namsau tawh a thahte sangin gialpi hangin a si mi tamzaw hi.
Tua ni-in Israyl mite mai-ah Yahweh in Amor mite a piak ni-in, Israyl-te omin Yahshua in Yahweh kiangah, “Ni aw, Gibeon tungah na khawllai inla, Kha aw, Aiyolon Kuam tungah na khawllai in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin mite in a galte uh tungah phu a lakkhit matengun ni khawl dide a, kha zong a pai kei hi. Hih thu Yasher Laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih manin van laizangah ni khawl dide-in a tumsuk dingin ni khat bup kiim a zekai hi.
Tua ma-in ahi a, tua khit nungah ahi zongin, Yahweh in tua ni banga mihing thu a ngaih hun a om ngei kei hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Israyl aa dingin a dosak hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israyl khempeuh tawh Gilgal-a giahphual ah Yahshua a ciah hi.
Hih a kipawlkhawm kumpi ngate tai-in Makkedah-a kuahawm sung khat ah a kibu uh hi.
Makkedah-a kuahawm sung ah kumpi ngate a kibukna a kimuhna thu Yahshua tungah a kigen hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua in, “Suangtum lianpite khukin kuahawm vang hu unla, mi pawlkhat cingsak un.
Ahih hangin khawl kei un! Na galte uh nungdelh unla, a nung panin sim un. A khuapite uh sungah lutsak kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa un note khut sungah amaute hong piakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahshua leh Israyl mi khempeuh in mihing khat dongin amaute a thatsiang dektak uh a, ahih hangin tawmno khat suakta-in a khuapi muanhuaite sungah a lut uh hi.
Tua ciangin Makkedah-a Yahshua kiangah mi khempeuh lungmuang takin a ciah uh hi. Israyl mite langah a kamkek ngam khat beek a om kei hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in, “Kuahawm hong unla, tua kumpi ngate ka kiangah hong paipih un,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in kuahawm panin kumpi ngate ahi: Yerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Yarmuth kumpipa, Lachish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa-te lakhia uh hi.

Amaute in Yahshua kiangah hih kumpite hong paipih uh ciangin, amah in Israyl mi khempeuh sam a, amah tawh a pai galmi’ makaite tungah, “Hong pai unla, hih kumpite ngawng ah na khe-un sik un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin amaute a mai-ah hong paikhia-in a ngawngte uh a khe uh tawh a sik hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute kiangah, “Lau kei unla, lungkia kei un. Thahat unla hangun; bang hang hiam cihleh note do na galte khempeuh tungah Yahweh in hih bangin bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in amaute satin a thatlupkhit ciangin, singkung nga tungah amaute khai a, nitak dong a khaina mun ah omlai hi.
Nitum ciangin Yahshua in thupia a, amaute in singkung tung panin lakhia-in, a bukna uh kuahawm sungah a paai uh hi. Amaute in kuahawm vangah suangtum lianpite koih uh a, tuni mahmah dong a omlai hi.

Tua ni-in Yahshua in Makkedah la hi. Amah in khuapi leh a kumpipa namsau-in that a, a sunga om mi khempeuh a susia kiukeuh hi. Amah in bangmah siit lo hi. Yericho kumpipa tungah a bawl bangin amah in Makkedah kumpipa tungah a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Makkedah panin Libnah ah Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh kikhinin, Libnah khua a do uh hi.

Yahweh in tua khuapi leh a kumpipa zong Israyl-te khut sungah a pia hi. Yahshua in khuapi leh a sunga om mi khempeuh namsau hiam tawh vatgawp hi. Amah in tua lai-ah kuamah a hing khawi kei hi; Yericho kumpipa tungah a bawl bangin hih kumpipa tungah a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Libnah panin Lachish ah Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh kikhin uh hi. Amaute in panmun la-in, tua ciangin Lachish a do uh hi.

Yahweh in Israyl-te khut sungah Lachish pia a, amaute in a ni nih ni-in tua khuapi la-in, a khuapi leh a sunga om mi khempeuh namsau hiam tawh a vatgawp hi. Amah in Libnah a bawl bangin Lachish tungah zong a hih hi.
Tua hun sungin Lachish a huh dingin Gazer kumpipa Horam kuanto a, ahih hangin Yahshua in amah leh a galkapte a suakta khat zong om loin a zogawp hi.
Tua khit ciangin Lachish panin Eglon ah Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh kikhin uh hi. Amaute in panmun la-in Eglon a do uh hi.
Tua ni-in amaute in a khuapi la uh a, namsau tawh vatgawp-in, Lachish a bawl bangun a khuapi sunga om peuhmah a susia maimang uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Eglon panin Hebron ah Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh paito uh a, Hebron a do uh hi.

Amaute in tua khuapi la uh a, namsau tawh a kumpipa, a khuaneute leh a sunga om peuhmah a that uh hi. Amaute in khatbeek a hingkhawi kei hi. Eglon ah a bawl bang teekteekun khuapi leh a sunga om peuhmah a susia maimang uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh kihei-in Debir a do uh hi.

Amaute in khuapi, a kumpipa leh a khuaneute la-in namsau tawh a vatgawp uh a, a sunga om khempeuh a susia maimang uh hi. Amaute in kuamah hingkhawi lo uh hi. Amaute in Libnah leh a kumpipa, leh Hebron tungah a bawl bangun Debir leh a kumpipa tungah a bawl uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahshua in tua kual buppi, a mualtung gam teng, Negev, nitumna lam zang leh kham teng, mualpang suk teng, leh a kumpite khempeuh ciat tawh a lakhawm hi. Amah in kuamah hingkhawi lo hi. Israyl’ Vanglianpen Pa, Yahweh in a thupiaksa bang teekteekin hu a sang khempeuh a susia maimang hi.
Kadesh Barnea panin Gaza ciang dong, Goshen kual buppi panin Gibeon ciang dong Yahshua in amaute a zo hi.
Israyl’ Pa Yahweh in Israyl aa dingin dosak ahih manin Yahshua in hih kumpite khempeuh leh a gamte do khatin a zo hi.
Tua khit ciangin Gilgal-a giahphual ah Yahshua leh amah tawh a om Israyl khempeuh a ciah uh hi.
Hazor kumpipa Yabin in hih thu a zak ciangin, Madon kumpipa Yobab kiang, Shimron kumpipa kiang, Acshaph kumpipa kiang,
mual laka teng leilulam kumpite kiang; Kinnereth leitaw-lama om Arabah, nitumna lam mualbul-ate leh nitumna-a Naphoth Dor kumpite kiang,
nisuahna lama om Canaan mite kiang, nitumna lama om Amor mite kiang, mualtung gama teng Hit mite, Periz* mite, Yebus mite, leh Mizpah gam sung Hermon nuai lama teng Hiv mite kiangah thu a puak hi.
Galkap a tam lua mahmah tuipi geia sehnel bangin a tam—amaute a zui a galkapte khempeuh leh sakolte leh leengte a honpi tawh amaute hong kuankhia uh hi.
Israyl a sim dingin hih kumpite khempeuh in galhatnate uh gawm uh a, Merom Tuite kiangah giahphual a sat khawm uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah, “Amaute hangin lau kei in. Zingciang tu hunin thahsa-in Israyl-te tungah amaute a vek khempeuhin kong pia ding hi. A sakol zaguite uh na attatsak ding uh a, a leengte uh mei sungah na haltum ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua leh amah tawh a om galdo mi khempeuh in Merom Tuite-a om amaute kiangah thakhatin pai-in a sim uh hi.

Yahweh in Israyl-te khut sungah amaute pia hi. Israyl-te in amaute zo-in a Lianzaw Sidon dong, Misrephoth Maim dong, leh nisuahna lama Mizpah Kuam dong amaute kuamah a nungta a om nawn mateng lam tawntung ah delh uh hi.
Yahweh in, “A sakol zaguite uh attatsakin a leengte mei sungah haltum in,” ci-in a thupiaksa bangin Yahshua in a hih hi.
Tua hun mahin Hazor leh a kumpipa a la dingin Yahshua a kilehkik hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Hazor pen a masa-in hih kumpigamte khempeuh’ lutang ahi hi.
Amaute in a sunga om khempeuh namsau tahin, a susiamang kiuhkeuh uh hi. Hu a sang peuhmah a hing omlo a, Hazor mahmah zong a haltum uh hi.
Tua kumpi khuapite khempeuh leh a kumpite khempeuh Yahshua in man-in namsau a tah hi. Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh in a thupiaksa bang teekteekin amah in apin a susiamang kiuhkeuh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshua in a haltumsa Hazor longal mualtunga om khuapite khempeuh; khuapi a kisiamang dikdekte*, khat zong Israyl-te in hal lo uh hi.

Israyl mite in tua khuapite sunga van kinusiate leh ganhingte amau aa dingin a la uh hi. Ahih hangin mihingte ahih leh a suksiat kiuhkeuh matengun namsau a tah uh hi. Amaute in kuamah hingkhawi lo uh hi.

Yahweh in a nasem Mosheh a thupiaksa bang teekteekin Mosheh in Yahshua thupia a, Yahshua in amah thu a kipiak bangin a sem hi. Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiak khempeuh sep loh a, a nusiat khat zong om lo hi.
Yahshua in hih gam khempeuh la hi: Mualtung gam teng, Negev khempeuh, Goshen kual buppi, nitumna lam mualbulte, Arabah leh Israyl mualliante a mualbulte uh—
Seir lam manawh-a a kikhung to Halak Mual panin Hermon Mual nuai Lebanon Kuam-a om Baal Gad ciang dong ahi hi. Amah in a kumpite khempeuh manin, amaute vattukin a that hi.
Hih kumpite tawh Yahshua ni tampi sung kido uh hi.
Gibeon-a teng Hiv mite lobuang Israyl mite tawh kilemna thuciam a bawl khuapi khatbeek om lo hi. Amaute in adangte khempeuh kidona panin a lak uh ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bangin amaute a suksiat kiuhkeuh theih nadingin amaute tungah lainatna laklohna tawh a ki-ap nate suaksakin Israyl a do theih nadingun a lungsimte uh a khauhsakpa pen Yahweh ahi hi.

Tua hun mahin Yahshua pai-a mualtung gama om: Hebron, Debir, leh Anab pan, Yahdah-te mualtung gam khempeuh pan, leh Israyl-te mualtung gam khempeuh panin Anak mite a susiamang hi. Yahshua in amaute leh a khuapite a susiamang kiuhkeuh hi.
Israyl mite gam ah Anak mite khat zong om nawn lo hi. Gaza, Gath leh Ashdod bek ah amaute om lai uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Mosheh a gensa bang lianin Yahshua in tua gam buppi la hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in amau minam tawh kizui-in a ngah dingin a kihawm bangin Israyl mite tungah gamh-in a pia hi. Tua ciangin galkidona panin tua gam a tawlnga hi.
Hihte pen Israyl mite in a zawhsa, Yardan nisuahna lampanga om, Arnon Gun panin Hermon Mual dong, Arabah nisuahna lampang khempeuh a laksa uh gama kumpite ahi hi:
Heshbon a uk Amor mite kumpipa Sihon ahi hi. Amah in Arnon Gun gei-a om Aroer, gun laizang panin Amor mite gamgi-a om Yabbok Gun dong a uk hi. Hih sungah Gilead gam langkhat a kihel hi.
Sihon in Kinnereth Tuipi; Galilee Tuipi, panin Arabah Tuipi (Ci Tuipi); Tuipi Si, dong, Beth Yeshimoth dong Arabah nisuahna lam uk a, Pisgah mualdung kikhungsuk nuaisan dong zong a uk hi.
Ashtaroth leh Erei a uk, Rephai mite kumpi nunungte laka khat ahi Bashan kumpipa’ gam pen,
Hermon Mual, Salecah, Bashan khempeuh panin Geshur leh Maacah’ mite gamgi, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon’ gamgi-a Gilead gam langkhat dong ahi hi.
Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh leh Israyl mite in tuate zo uh hi. Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh in Reuben leh Gad, Menasheh minam-alangte tungah Yardan nisuahna lamah amau’ luah ahi dingin tua gamte a pia hi.

Hihte pen Yahshua leh Israyl mite in Yardan hih lampang leh nitumna lampang, Lebanon Kuam-a Baal Gad panin Seir lama a kikhungto Halak Mual ciang dongah a zawh uh gama kumpite ahi hi. Hih kumpite’ gam pen Israyl minam tawh kizui-in a ngah dingin a kihawm bangin Yahshua in Israyl minamte tungah a pia hi—
mualtung gam teng, nitumna lam mualbul, Arabah mual kikhungsuk, sehnel gam leh Negev ciang—Hit mite gam, Amor mite gam, Canaan mite gam, Periz mite gam, Hiv mite gam leh Yebus mite gam ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau gamte panin a kizo kumpite ahi hi: Yericho kumpipa, khat; Beth-El nai-a Ai kumpipa, khat;
Yerusalem kumpipa, khat; Hebron kumpipa, khat;
Yarmuth kumpipa, khat; Lachish kumpipa, khat;
Eglon kumpipa, khat; Gazer kumpipa, khat;
Debir kumpipa, khat; Geder kumpipa, khat;
Hormah kumpipa, khat; Arad kumpipa, khat;
Libnah kumpipa, khat; Adullam kumpipa, khat;
Makkedah kumpipa, khat; Beth-El kumpipa, khat;
Tappuah kumpipa, khat; Hepher kumpipa, khat;
Aphek kumpipa, khat; Lasharon kumpipa, khat;
Madon kumpipa, khat; Hazor kumpipa, khat;
Shimron Meron kumpipa, khat; Achshaph kumpipa, khat;
Taanach kumpipa, khat; Megiddo kumpipa, khat;
Kedesh kumpipa, khat; Carmel-a Yokneam kumpipa, khat;
Naphoth Dor gama Dor kumpipa, khat; Gilgal-a Goyim kumpipa, khat;
Tirzah kumpipa, khat ahi hi. Hih kumpite khempeuh sawmthum le khat a pha hi.
Yahshua’ kum kicing mahmah ta-in a teek ciangin, Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Na kum a cing mahmah ta a, ahi zongin lak ding leitang a zai mahmah om lai hi.
Hihte pen lak ding a kisamlai gamte ahi hi: Philistia mite leh Geshur mite gam khempeuh—

Egypt nisuahna lama om Shihor Gun panin leilu lama Ekron gam ciang dong, a vekpi-in Canaan mite aa bangin kisim hi. (Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath leh Ekron gamte a uk Philistia-te gam ngate ahi hi.) Avvim-te gam zong kihel hi;
leitaw lam panin, Canaan mite leitang khempeuh, Sidon mite gama Arah panin Aphek huam sung, Amor mite gamgi dong ban hi;
Gebal mite gam, nisuahna lama Lebanon gam khempeuh, Hermon Mual nuai lama Baal Gad panin Hamath lutna ciang dong ahi hi.

Lebanon panin Misrephoth Maim ciang dong mualtung gama a tengte khempeuh leh Sidon mi khempeuh, Israyl mite mai panin Kei mahmah in ka hawlkhia ding hi. Note thu kong piaksa bangin luah dingin Israyl tungah na hawm ding uh hi.
Minam kua leh Menasheh minam-alangte lakah luah dingin na hawm ding uh hi.
Yahweh’ nasem Mosheh in amaute tungah a piaksa bangin Mosheh in amaute tungah Yardan nisuahna lamah a piaksa, adang Menasheh minam-alangte, Reuben leh Gad minamte in a luahna ngahkhin uh hi.
Amaute’ ngahna pen Arnon Gun gei-a Aroer pan, leh kuam laizanga om khuapi pan, leh Medeba leitamzang buppi kihelin Dibon dong ahi hi:
Amor mite gamgi ciang dong Heshbon ah a uk Amor mite kumpipa Sihon’ khuapite khempeuh ahi hi.
Gilead; Gershur mite leh Maacah mite’ gam; Hermon Mual khempeuh; Bashan gam khempeuh; leh Salecah dong a kihel hi—
Ashtaroth leh Edrei ah a uk Bashan-a om Og’ kumpigam buppi, amah pen Rephai mite lakah a suakta a nunungpen khat bek a omlaipa ahi hi. Mosheh in amaute zogawpin a hawlkhia hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl mite in Geshur leh Maacah mite hawlkhia lo uh ahih manin tuni dongin Israyl mite lakah amaute a teng toto lai uh hi.

Ahih hangin Levi mite tungah Mosheh in luah ding bangmah pia lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute tungah a gen bangin Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh tungah mei tawh kihal biaknate pen amaute luah ahi hi.
Hih pen Mosheh in Reuben minamte tungah a behbehin a piaksa ahi hi:
Arnon Gun gei-a om Aroer pan, kuam laizanga khuapi pana gam, Medeba leitamzang buppi,
Heshbon leh leitamzang-a om a khuapite khempeuh dong hi a, Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
Yatzah, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
Kiryathaim, Sibmah, kuam mualtunga Zereth Shahar,
Beth Peor, Pisgah mualdung suk teng leh Beth Yeshimoth-te zong a kihel hi.

Hihte ah Leitamzanga khuapite khempeuh leh Heshbon ah a uk Amor mite kumpipa Sihon’ vaihawmna gam buppi a kihel hi. Mosheh in amah leh Midian mi makaite ahi: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, leh Reba zokhin a, amaute pen tua gama teng Sihon tawh a kizom kumpi-tapate ahi uh hi.
Gal sungah a kithatte banah Beor’ tapa muhkholh theihna leh mailam thu ding a gen Balaam zong Israyl mite in that uh hi.
Reuben minamte’ gam huam pen Yardan gun pang ahi hi. Hih khuapite leh a khuaneute pen a behbehin Reuben minamte’ luah ahi hi.
Hih pen Mosheh in Gad minamte tungah a behbehin a piakte ahi hi:
Yazer gam, Gilead khuapite khempeuh leh Rabbah nai-a Ammon mite gam alang Aroer ciang dong;
Heshbon panin Ramath Mizpah leh Betonim ciang dong, Mahanaim panin Debir’ gamgi ciang dong;
kuam sungah, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, leh Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon’ vaihawmna gam a omlai teng (Yardan nisuahna lampanga Kinnereth Tuipi mong; Galilee Tuipi, donga gam ciang) ahi hi.
Hih khuapite leh a khuaneute pen Gad minamte in a behbehin a luah uh ahi hi.
Hih pen Mosheh in Menasheh minam-alangte tungah a piak hi a, tua pen Menasheh innkuante’ suan alang tungah a behbehin a piak ahi hi:
Tua gam pen Mahanaim panin kikhunga Bashan khempeuh, Bashan kumpipa Og vaihawmna buppi—Bashan gama Yair-te khua khempeuh khuapi sawmguk,

Gilead gam alang; Ashtaroth, leh Edrei (Bashan gama Og’ neihsa ahi kumpi khuapite) ciang ahi hi. Tua pen Menasheh’ tapa Makir’ suanlekhakte aa ding ahi hi—Makir’ tapate alang aa dingin a behbehin a tanh ding uh ahi hi.
Hih pen Yericho nisuahna Yardan gal Moab leitamzangte ah Mosheh a om lai-in amaute’ luah dingin a piaksa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Levi minam tungah Mosheh in luah ding bangmah pia lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amaute a ciamsa bang lianin Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh pen amau’ luah ahi hi.
Hihte pen siampi Eleazar, Nun’ tapa Yahshua, leh Israyl minam sung pan beh lutangte in amaute tungah a piak, Canaan gam sungah Israyl mite in gamh-a a ngah gamte ahi hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiaksa bang lianin amau’ luahte pen minam kuate leh minam-alangte tungah aisanna tawh kipia hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Mosheh in minam nihte leh minam alangte Yardan nisuahna lampang ah a luah ding uh piakhin hi; ahih hangin amaute laka Levi mite tungah amah in luah ding pia lo hi.

Tu-in Yahseph’ tapate minam nih suak uh hi—Menasheh leh Ephraim ahi hi. Levi mite, a khuapite sungah tengin, a gankhawite leh a neihsate aa dingin neihkhop-gam lobuang gam hawmna panin sehtanh a ngah kei uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh a thupiaksa bang teekteekin Israyl mite in tua bangin gam a hawm uh hi.

Tu-in Gilgal-a Yahshua kiangah Yahdah mite hong pai uh hi. Keniz mi Yephunneh’ tapa Caleh in ama kiangah, “Kadesh Barnea ah Yahweh in a mipa Mosheh tungah nang leh kei’ thu hong genna bang hiam cih na thei hi.
Kadesh Barnea panin gam thu a kan ding leh gam zong dingin Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in kei hong sawl lai-in kum 40 ka pha hi. Kei muhna bangin ama kiangah thu ka puakkik hi.
Ahih hangin kei tawh a paikhawm ka sanggamte in mipite lungtang launa tawh tuisuaksakin, mite lungsim puksak hi. Ahih hangin keimah in ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ka Pa Yahweh ka zui hi.

Tua ahih manin tua ni-in kei tungah Mosheh hong kiciam a, ‘Ka Pa Yahweh na lungsim khempeuh tawh zui na hih manin na khe a na siikna mun peuhpeuh nang luah hi ding a, na tate aa hi tawntung ding hi,’ hong ci hi.

Tu-in Yahweh in a ciamsa bang lianin sehnel gama Israyl a vakvak hun sung Amah in Mosheh kiangah hih thu a gen huna kipanin kum sawmli le kum nga sung Amah in a nungta-in kei hong kem hi. Tua ahih manin tuni-in hih lai mun ah, keimah kum 85 ka pha hi.
Mosheh in hong sawl huna mah bangin tuni-in ka thahat lai hi. Gal ka kuan ngei bangin tu-in zong galkuan na dingzah thahatna ka nei hi.

Tu-in tua ni-in Yahweh in hong ciamsa hih mualtung gam kei hong pia in. Anak mite tua lai-ah a omna leh a khuapite uh lianin a muanhuai khuapite ahihna na zaksa ahi hi. Yahweh in kei hong panpih leh, Yahweh in gen bang teekteekin amaute a hawlkhia zo ding ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb thupha pia-in a luah dingin ama tungah Hebron a pia hi.
Amah in lungsim khempeuh tawh Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh zui ahih manin Hebron pen tuni dongin Keniz mi Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb’ gamh-luah a suak hi.
Hebron pen Anak mite laka mi lianpen Kiryath Arba; Arba a tap-in, a kicisa ahi hi. Tua ciangin galkidona panin tua gam a tawlnga hi.
A behbehin Yahdah minam aa dingin sehtanh pen Edom gamgi dong kikhungsukin, leitaw lampek Zin Sehnel gam dong ahi hi.
A leilu lam gamgi pen Ci Tuipi; Tuipi Si, ii leitaw lam mong-a a sun tuidawk pan kipan a,
Akrabbim Kahtohna leitaw lam kantanin Zin ah kizom suaka Kadesh Barnea leitaw lam ah paisuak hi. Tua ciangin Hezron dung tawnin Addar lam ah kikhungto-a, Karka a kualkhum hi.
Tua ciangin Azmon dungah pai-in Egypt Wadi zoma, tuipi ah tawp hi. Hih pen amaute’ leitaw lam gamgi ahi hi.
Nisuahna lam gamgi pen Ci Tuipi; Tuipi Si, dung Yardan tun dong ahi hi. Leilu lam gamgi pen Yardan tunna tuipi dawk panin kipan a,
Beth Hoglah ah paito-in Beth Arabah leilu lam zoma Reuben’ tapa Bohan’ Suangpi ah paito hi.
Achor kuam panin Debir ah a paito gamgi pen Gilgal lam manawhin leilu lamah kihei-a, kuam leitaw lama Adummim Ciangpi a maingat hi. En Shemesh Tuite dungah kizomsuak a, En Rogel ah suakkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Ben Hinnom Kuam dong Yerusalem khuapi-a Yebus mite’ leitaw lam dungah zui-in paito hi. Tua panin Rephaim Kuam leilu lam mong-a om Hinnom Kuam nitumna lam mualneu dawnah a kahto hi.
Mualneu dawn panin gamgi, Nephtoah Tuinakte lam maingatin Ephron Mual-a khuapite ah suakkhia-in, Baalah (Kiryath Yearim) lam ah paisuk hi.
Tua ciangin Baalah panin Sier Mual lamah kawiphei a, Yearim Mual (tua pen, Kesalon) dung leilu lamah paisukin Beth Shemesh zomsuk a, Timnah ah a galkah hi.
Tuateh Ekron leilu-lam dung zui a, Shikkeron lam ah kihei phei-in Baalah Mual dung kantana Yabneel a ban hi. Tuipi ah gamgi tawp hi.
Nitumna lam gamgi pen Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean Tuipi, dung ahi hi. Hihte pen amau behte tawh kizui-in Yahdah mite kiimkot-a gamgite ahi hi.
Yahshua tunga Yahweh’ kammal tawh kizui-in Yahdah minam’ laizang ah amah in Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah gamh a pia hi. Yahshua in Kiryath-Arba, tua pen Hebron a pia hi. (Arba pen Anak’ pupi ahi hi.)
4 Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb in tua lai panin Anak’ tapa thum –Sheshai, Ahiman, leh Talmai (Anak’ suanlekhakte) hawlkhia hi.
Tua lai panin Debir-a tengte do dingin amah paito hi. Debir pen nidangin Kiryath-Sepher kici hi.
Caleb in, “Kiryath-Sepher do-in a lazo peuhpeuh tungah a zi dingin ka tanu Achsah ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Caleb’ sanggampa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel in lazo ahih manin amah a tenpih dingin Caleb in a tanu Achsah a pia hi.

Tua nu a tun ciangin, tua nu in a pa kiangah lo khat a ngetna dingin a sawl gawp hi. Tua nu a laa tung pan a tuahkhiat ciangin Caleb in ama kiangah, “Nang aa ding bang kong hihsak ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Amah in, “A tuam vilvel thupha hong pia in. Negev ah leitang nong piak khit nungsang, tuikhukte zong hong pia in,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ahih manin Caleb in tuikhuk tungnung leh tuikhuk nuainungte a pia hi.
Hih pen a behbehin Yahdah minamte’ gamh ahi hi:
Negev sunga om, Edom tawh gamgi lampang leitaw lam a nehpen Yahdah minamte neih khuapite in: Kabzeel, Eder, Yagur,
Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
Kadesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
Hazor Hadattah, Kiryath Hezron (Tua pen Hazor),
Amam, Shema, Moladah,
Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Bizyothyah; Yahweh in huathuaisa a cihna ahi hi,
baalah, Iyim, Ezem,
Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,
Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, leh Rimmon hi a, a vekpi gawmin khuapi 29 leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Mualbul nitumna lamte ah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
Yarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
Shaaraim, Adithaim, leh Gederah, leh Gederothaim hi a, khuapi sawm le li leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
Dilean, Mizpah, Yoktheel,
Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
Cabbon, Lahmam, Kithlish,
Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, leh Makkedah hi a, khuapi sawm le guk leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
Yiphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
Keilah, Achzib, leh Mareshah hi a, khuapi kua leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Ekron, a kiimkota a tengte leh a khuatate tawh;
Ekron nitumna lam, Ashdod-a khua vengte khempeuh, a khuatate tawh;
Ashdod, a kiimkota a tengte leh a khuatate tawh; Gaza, a khuaneute leh a khuatate, Egypt Wadi leh Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean Tuipi; ciang dong ahi hi.
Mualtung gam ah: Shamir, Yattir,Sochoh,
Dannah, Kiryath Sannah (Tua pen Debir),
Anab, Eshtemoth, Anim,
Goshen, Holon, leh Giloh hi a, khuapi sawm le khat leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
Yanum, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
Humtah, Kiryath Arba (Tua pen Hebron), leh Zior hi a, khuapi kua leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Yuttah,
Yezreel, Yokdeam, Zanoah,
Kain, Gibeah, leh Timnah hi a, khuapi sawm leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

Kiryath Baal (Tua pen Kiryath Yearim) leh Rabbah hi a, khuapi nih leh a khuatate ahi hi.

Ci Khuapi Nibshan leh En Gedi hi a, khuapi guk leh a khuatate ahi hi.
Yahdah in Yerusalem-a teng Yebus mite hawlkhia zolo hi. Tuni dongin Yerusalem ah Yahdah mite tawh Yebus mite teng khawm uh hi.
Yahseph mite aa dingin sehtanh pen Yericho tuite’ nisuahna lam Yericho kiang Yardan pan kipan a, tua lai panin paito-in sehnel gam kantan a, Beth-El mualtung gam sungah a lutto hi.
Beth-El (tua pen Luz) panin paito-in, Ataroth-a Ark mite’ gamgi kantan a,
Yaphlet mite gamgi ah nitumna lam tawnin tuaksuk a, Beth Horon Nuainung kual Gezer dong bansukin tuipi ah a tawp hi.
Tua bangin Yahseph tapate ahi Menasheh leh Ephraim in a gamh uh a ngah uh hi.
Hih pen a behbehin Ephraim’ gam ahi hi: Amau luah gamgi pen Beth Horon Tungnung nisuahna lama om Ataroth Addar panin pai a,
tuipi ah kizom hi. Michmethath panin leilu lam manawhin Taanath Shiloh dong nisuahna lam manawhin kualto a, nisuahna lam Yanoah dongah a kantan hi.
Tua ciangin Yanoah panin Ataroth leh Naarah ah tuaksuk a, Yericho nawkin Yardan ah a suakkhia hi.
Gamgi Tappuah panin nitumna lam manawhin Kanah Ravine ah pai-in tuipi ah a tawp hi. Hih pen a behbehin Ephraim minam’ luah ahi hi.
Menasheh mite’ luah sung panin Ephraim mite aa dingin kikhenkhia-in a kituamkoih a khuaneute leh a khuatate zong a kihel hi.
Amaute in Gazer-a teng Canaan mite hawlkhia lo uh hi. Tuni dongin Ephraim mite lakah Canaan mite teng lai hi; ahih hangin zawhthawh thu-in na kisemsak hi.

Yahseph’ tacil ahih manin hih sehtanh pen Menasheh minam aa ding ahi hi. Menasheh tacil’ Makir tungah kipia hi. Makir pen Gilead mite pianna hi a, Makir mite pen galhang mite ahih manun Gilead leh Bashan amau ngahsa ahi hi.

A behbehin Menasheh mi a omlaite—Abiezer beh, Helek beh, Asriel beh, Shechem beh, Hepher beh leh Shemida beh-te aa dingin sehtanh a om hi. Hihte pen a behbehin Yahseph’ tapa Menasheh suanlekhak adang pasalte ahi hi.
Tu-in Menasheh’ tapa Makir, a tapa Gilead, a tapa Hepher, Hepher’ tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei loin tanu bek nei a, a minte uh pen Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah leh Tirzah ahi hi.

Siampi Eleazar, Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh mihon makaite kiangah amaute pai uh a, “Ka sanggamte lakah gamh hong kipiak nadingin Yahweh in Mosheh thupia hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh thupiakna bangin Yahshua a pa’ sanggamte uh tungah gamh a piak ciangin amaute zong gamh a pia hi.
Menasheh sehtanh tacil hamphatna sungah Gilead leh Yardan nisuahna lam Bashan banah leitang khen sawm a tanh thuah hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Menasheh minam’ ta numeite in ta pasalte lakah gamh a ngah uh hi. Gilead gam pen Menasheh suanlekhak a omlaite aa ahi hi.
Menasheh gam pen Asher panin Shechem nisuahna Michmethath dong zai hi. Leitaw lama gamgi in tua lai panin En Tappuah-a teng mite dong a huam hi.
(Menasheh in Tappuah leitang a neih hangin Tappuah mahmah zong Menasheh gamgi huam sungah om a Ephraim-te aa ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin gamgi in Kanah Kuampi leitaw lam ah zom hi. Tua lai-a Menasheh khuapite lakah Ephraim-te khuapite om a, ahih hangin Menasheh gamgi tua Kuampi leilu lam ah pai-in tuipi ah a tawp hi.
A leitaw lam Ephraim-te gam hi a, leilu lam ah Menasheh-te gam ahi hi. Menasheh-te gam in tuipi bana, a leilu lam ah Asher tawh kigamgi-in, nisuahna lam ah Issachar tawh kigamgi hi.
Issachar leh Asher sungah Menasheh in zong Beth Shan, Ibleam leh Dor, Endor Taanach leh Megiddo mite a kiimkota khuaneute tawh (a kigualhna ah a thumna pen Naphoth Dor) ahi hi.
Tua hi napi-in Canaan mite tua huam lam ah teng dingin khensat uh ahih manin Menasheh mite in tua khuapite ah a tengte a hawlkhia zo kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl mite a thahat semsem uh ciangin amaute in Canaan mite zawhthawh thu tawh na semsak uh a, ahih hangin hawlkhia siang kiuhkeuh lo uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahseph mite in Yahshua kiangah, “Bang hangin kote sehtanh khat bek hong pia-in ka luah dingun khenkhat bek hong pia na hi hiam? Kote ka tam mahmah uh a, Yahweh in thupha a dimin hong pia hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahshua in amaute dawng a, “Na tam luat uh a, Ephraim mualtung gam teng no aa dingin a neu luat leh gammang-tulak ah paito unla, Periz mite leh Rephai mite leitang nomau gam dingin sat un,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahseph mite in, “Mualtung gam kote aa dingin kicing lo a, leitamzanga teng Canaan mite khempeuh, Beth Shan leh amau tawh a tengte leh Yezreel Kuama a tengte in sik leeng a nei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Yahseph innkuan—Ephraim leh Menasheh tungah, “Note na tam uh a, thahatna lianpi na nei uh hi. Note in sehtanh khat bek na ngah kei ding uh hi.

Note in gammang-tulak mualtung gam zong na ngah ding uh hi. Hah siang unla, a gamla pen a kiciang tanna ciangciang note aa ahi ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Canaan mite in sik leengte nei-in a thahat uh hangin note in Canaan mite na hawlkhia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shiloh ah Israyl mihon buppi kikaikhawm uh a, tua lai mun ah Kikhopna Puanbuk a lam uh hi. Amaute mai-ah tua gam ki-ukna nuai-ah a omkhin hi.
Ahih hangin a gamh uh a ngah nai lo Israyl mite lak ah minam sagih omlai hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Israyl mite kiangah, “Na pate uh Pa, Yahweh in hong piaksa gam na lak ding uh bang tanvei ngak ding na hi uh hiam?

Na minam ciat uh panin mi thumta nomau mah in teel un. Keimah in amaute leitang a teh nading leh amau luah ding ciat tawh kizui-in a leitang omziate hong gelh nadingun amaute ka sawl ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute hong ciahkikin kei tungah thu hong puak ding uh hi.
Amaute in seh sagihin amaute lakah khen ding uh hi. Yahdah pen leitaw lam ama gam ah omsuak ding a, Yahseph innkuan pen leilu lam ama gam ah omsuak ding hi.
Gam khen sagih omziate na gelhkhit uh ciangin, Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah note aa dingin aisanna ka lot theih nadingin ka kiangah hong paipih un.

Levi mite in note lakah sehtanh ngah lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ siampi nasepna pen amau’ luah ahi hi. Gad, Reuben leh Menasheh minam-alangte in Yardan nisuahna lampang ah amau’ luah ding ngahkhin zo uh hi. Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in amaute tungah a pia hi,” a ci hi.

Mite dingkhia-in Yahshua in gam ciaptehna a nei dingte tungah, “Gam sung teng teh kawikawi-in gam omziate va suai unla, Yahweh’ Omna Shiloh hih lai mun ah note aa dingin aisanna ka lot theih nadingin ka kiangah hong paipihkik un,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin mite kuankhia-in gam sung khempeuh ah a pai uh hi. Amaute in a gam omziate a khuakhua-in khen sagih suahin laizial khat tungah gelh-in, Shiloh giahphual-a Yahshua kiangah a ciahkik uh hi.
Yahshua in Shiloh ah Yahweh omin amau aa dingin aisanna lotsak a, Israyl mite amau beh phungpi tawh kizui-in tua lai-ah gam a hawmsak hi.
A behbehin Benyamin minam tungah aisanna a MASA-in kia hi. Amau’ tungah a kia aisanna pen Yahdah minam leh Yahseph minamte kikal-a gam ahi hi.
A leilu lampang ah Benyamin’ gamgi pen Yardan ah kipan a, Yericho leilu-lam siik kantanin, nitumna lam manawhin mualtung gamah lut a, Beth Aven sehnel gam ah suakkhia hi.
Tua lai panin Luz (tua pen Beth-El) leitaw lam siik kantan a, Beth Horon Nuainung leitaw lam mualtung Ataroth Addon ah paisuk hi.

Mual panin Beth Horon maingatin gamgi leitaw lamah kihei-in nitumna lampang leitaw lam ah kihei a, Yahdah mite khuapi khat ahi Kiryath Baal (tua pen Kiryath Yearim) ah suakkhia hi. Hih pen nitumna lampang ahi hi.
A leitaw lampang uh pen nitumna lama Kiryath Yearim mongte panin kipan a, Nephtoah Tuite nak ah gamgi suakkhia hi.
Gamgi pen mual bul ah paisukin Rephaim Kuam leilu lam-a Ben Hinnom Kuam maingat hi. Hinnom Kuam zomsuk a, Yebus mite khuapi siik leitaw lam ah paisukin En Rogel a tungsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin leilu lam ah kual a, En Shemesh ah pai-in Adummim Ciangpi a maingat Geliloth tawh kizomin Reuben’ tapa Bohan’ Suangpi a bansuk hi.
Tua in Beth Arabah leilu lam siik zom a, Arabah sungah a lutsuk hi.
Tua khit ciangin Beth Hoglah leilu lam siik ah pai a, leitaw lama Yardan mong Ci Tuipi; Tuipi Si, dawk leilu lam ah suakkhia hi. Hih pen a leitaw lam gamgi uh ahi hi.
Yardan in nisuahna lampang a gamgi piangsak hi. Hihte pen Benyamin behte luah ding a kiimkot khempeuh-a a kiciamteh gamgite ahi hi.
A behbehin Benyamin minamte in a nuai-a khuapite nei uh hi: Yericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Beth-El,
Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
Kephar Ammoni, Ophni, leh Geba hi a, khuapi sawm le nih leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

Zelah, Haeleph, Yebus mite khuapi (tua pen Yerusalem), Gibeah, leh Kiryath hi a, khuapi sawm le li leh a khuatate ahi hi. Hih pen Benyamin minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a gamh uh ahi hi.
A behbehin Simeon minam tungah aisanna a NIHNA-in kia hi. Yahdah minam gamhuam sungah aisanna tu hi.
Amaute gamh huam khakte in: Beersheba (ahih keileh Sheba), Moladah,
Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
