Beth Lebaoth leh Sharuhen hi a, khuapi sawm le thum leh a khuatate ahi hi;
Ain, Rimmon, Ether, leh Ashan hi a, khuapi li leh a khuatate ahi hi—
Hih khuaneute kiimkot, Baalath Beer (Negev sunga Ramah) khuatate khempeuh ahi hi. Hih pen a behbehin Simeon minam’ gamh ahi hi.
Yahdah’ tanh amau kisap zah sangin tamzaw ahih manin Simeon minam’ gamh pen Yahdah tanh sung panin kilaksak hi. Tua ahih manin Simeon minam in Yahdah gamhuam sungah a gamh uh a ngah uh hi.
A behbehin Zebulun minam tungah aisanna a THUMNA-in kia hi. Aisanna tawh a ngah amau gamgite huam pen Sarid dong ahi hi:
Nitumna lam manawh in Maralah lam ah pai-a, Dabbesheth nawkin Yokneam kianga ciangpi dongah a kikhung hi.
Sarid panin nisuahna lam ah kihei a, Kisloth Tabor gama nisuahna mun lam manawhin Daberath ciang dong pai-a Yaphia ciang dong a ban hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna lam ah Gath Hepher leh Eth Kazin dong kizom hi; Rimmon ah suakkhia-in tua khit ciangin Neah lam ah a kihei hi.
Neah panin Hannathon leilu lam kiimkotin pai-a, Yiphthah El Kuam ah tawp hi.
Amau luahna sungah khuapi sawm le nih leh a khuatate om a, Kattath, Nalialal, Shimron, Idalah, leh Bethlehem-te kihel hi.
Hih khuapite leh a khuatate uh pen Zebulun minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a luah uh ahi hi.
A behbehin Issachar minam tungah aisanna a LINA-in kia hi.
A aisanna pana ngah gam leh a kihel khuapite in: Yezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth,
En Gannim, En Haddah, leh Beth Pazzez ahi hi.
A gamgi in Tabor, Shahazumah leh Beth Shemesh ban a, Yardan ah a tawp hi. Khuapi sawm le guk leh a khuatate a om hi.
Hih khuapite leh a khuatate pen Issachar minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a luah uh ahi hi.
A behbehin Asher minam tungah aisanna a NGANA-in kia hi.
A aisanna pana ngah gam leh a kihel khuapite in: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
Allammelech, Amad, leh Mishal ahi hi. Nitumna lama a gamgi in Carmel leh Shihor Libnath ban hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna Beth Dagon lam ah kihei-in, Zebulun leh Yiphthah El Kuam nawkin leilu lam manawhin Beth Emek leh Neiel ah pai-a, Cabul veilam pangah kantan hi.
Tua ciangin Hebron, Rehob, Hammon, leh Kanah ah pai-in Sidon Lianzaw dong a sun hi.
Tua khit ciangin Ramah ah gamgi kihei a, kulhpi a nei Tyre khuapi ah pai hi. Tua ciangin Hosah ah gamgi kihei-in Aczib,
Ummah, Aphek, leh Rehob kual-a tuipi ah suakkhia hi. Tua lai-ah khuapi sawm nih le nih leh a khuatate a om hi.
Hih khuapite leh a khuatate pen Asher minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a luah uh ahi hi.
A behbehin Naphtali minam tungah aisanna a GUKNA-in kia hi.
Aisanna pana a gamgi uh pen Heleph leh Zaanannim-a singkung lianpi panin Adami Nekeb leh Yabneel kantanin Lakkum ah paisuak a, Yardan ah tawp hi.
Gamgi pen Aznoth Tabor nawkin nitumna lam ah pai a, Hukkok ah suakkhia-in leitaw lam Zebulun nawkin nitumna lam ah Asher ban a, nisuahna lam panin Yardan ah Yahdah a ban hi.
Kulh a nei khuapite pen Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Yinnereth,
Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, leh Beth Shemesh ahi hi. Khuapi sawm le kua leh a khuatate a om hi.
Hih khuapite leh a khuatate pen Naphtali minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a luah uh ahi hi.
A behbehin Dan minam tungah aisanna a SAGIHNA-in kia hi.
Aisanna pana a gama a kihel khuapite pen Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,
Shaalabbin, Aiyalon, Yethlah,
Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
Yahd, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
Me Yarkon, leh Rakkon, Yaffo gal kuam teng tawh ahi hi.

(Ahih hangin Dan minam gamgi pen hihte nangawn khengval lai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Dan behte kuanto-in Leshem simin la uh a, amaute in haksapi-in gam a neih theih nadingun la uh hi. Amaute in namsau hiam tawh vatgawpin a gam luah uh a, a sungah teng uh hi. Amaute in Leshem a min laihin a pupi uh ahi Dan’ min tapin Dan a ci uh hi.)
Hih khuapite leh a khuatate pen Dan minam in amau behte tawh kizui-in a luah uh ahi hi.
Amaute in amau sehtanh ciat ding bangin a gam uh a hawm khit uh ciangin Israyl mite in amaute lakah Nun’ tapa Yahshua gamh luah khat,
Yahweh in a thupiaksa bang lianin pia uh a, amah in a nget ahi Ephraim mualtung gama Timnath Serah gam amaute in a pia uh hi. Amah in khuapi lam phakikin tua lai-ah a teng hi.

Hihte pen siampi Eleazar, Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh Israyl beh phungpi lutangte in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna Yahweh omna-a Shiloh ah ai-lotna tawh a hawm uh gamte ahi hi. Hih bangin amaute gam hawm a man ta uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Yahshua kiangah a gen inah:
“Israyl mite kiangah gen inla, amaute kiangah, “Mosheh tungtawnin note kong hilhsa bang teekteekin bukna khuapite seh un;
Sawm lohpi-in ahi a, theih lohna hangin ahi zongin mi khat a that khapa a thei theih nading hi a, sisan-phu lapa kiang panin kidal nading leh kihut theih nadingin zong thei ding hi.

Hih khuapite khat ah a tai ciangin khuapi kulhkongpi ah dingin, tua khuapi upate mai-ah a thupiang a telgen ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in khuapi sungah lutsak ding a, amaute tawh a ten theih nading mun khat pia ding hi.
Sisan-phu lapa in amah nungdelh kha thei ding a, amah in sawm lohpi-in leh sawmkholhna tawh a that hilo ahih manin amaute in lungsim kikhatin sisan-phu lapa kiangah ap peuhmah lo ding hi.

Thukhenna thuak dingin mihonte mai-ah a din mateng, tua hun lai-in nasem siampi lian pa a sih mateng tua khuapi sungah a teng ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah a taikhiatna khuapi-a a inn ah a ciahkik thei ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin amaute in Naphtali mualtung gam sunga Galilee gam sung panin Kedesh khua, Ephraim mualtung gam sunga Shechem khua, leh Yahdah mualtung gam sunga Kiryath Arba (tua pen Hebron) teel uh hi. Hihte pen Yardan nitumna lampanga bukna khuapite ahi hi.

Yericho nisuahna lampang Yardan galkhat ah Reuben minam sung panin leitamzang sehnel gam ah Bezer khua, Gad minam sung panin Gilead gam sung Ramoth khua, leh Menasheh minam sung panin Bashan gam sung Golan khua teel uh hi.

Hihte pen Israyl mite aa ding leh amaute laka a peem khualmi khatpeuh aa ding, sawm lopi-in mi khat a that khapa pen mihonte mai-ah sittelna tuakin a din ma-in sisan-phulapa khut ah a sih khak loh nadingin a tai theih nadinga a kiteel khuapite ahi hi.
Tu-in Levi mi lutangte in siampi Eleazar, Nun’ tapa Yahshua leh Israyl adang minam lutangte kiangah hong pai uh hi.

Amaute in Canaan gam sung Shiloh mun ah, “Ten nadingin khuapi leh ka gankhawite uh aa dingin neihkhop-gam nong piak theih nadingun Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin thu piazo hi,” ci-in amaute kiangah a gen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh thupiaksa bang teekteekin Israyl mite in Levi mite tungah a nuai-a khuapite leh amau luah sung mahmah panin neihkhop-gamte a pia uh hi:

A behbehin Kohath suanlekhakte aa dingin aisanna pana a ngah khiat pen hih bang ahi hi. Siampi Aaron’ suante laka kihel Levi mite aa dingin amaute in Yahdah, Simeon, leh Benyamin’ minamte tung panin ai-lotna tawh khuapi sawm le thum pia uh hi.
A om lai Kohath’ suante in Ephraim, Dan leh Menasheh minam-alangte a behbehte tung panin khuapi sehtanh khuapi sawm ngah uh hi.
Gershon’ suanlekhakte in Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, leh Bashan-a Menasheh minam-alangte a behbehte tung panin sehtanh khuapi sawm le thum ngah uh hi.
A behbehin Merari’ suanlekhakte in Reuben, Gad leh Zebulun minamte tung panin khuapi sawm le nih ngah uh hi.
Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiaksa bang teekteekin Israyl mite in Levi minam tungah hih khuapite leh a neihkhop-gamte uh hih bang danin pia uh hi.
Yahdah mite’ minam pan leh Simeon mite’ minam panin amaute in a nuai-a khuapite a minmin-in pia uh hi:
(Tu-in hih khuapite pen Aaron’ suanlekhakte tung, Levi mi Kohath mite behte tungah kipia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh aisanna a masa pen amau tungah kia hi.)
Amaute in Yahdah mualtung gam sunga Kiryath Arba (tua pen Hebron) leh a neihkhop-gamte tawh amaute a pia uh hi. (Arba pen Anak pianna pupi ahi hi.)
Ahih hangin khuapi kiimkota lote leh a khuatate Yephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah a luah dingin a piaksa uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin siampi Aaron’ suanlekhakte tungah amaute in Hebron (mi thata a kingawhpa aa dingin bukna khuapi ahi hi), Libnah,
Yattir, Eshtemoa,
Holon, Debir,
Ain, Yuttah, leh Beth Shemesh, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, hih minam nih tung panin khuapi kua ahi hi;
Benyamin minam panin amaute in Levi mite tungah: Gibeon, Geba,
Anathoth, leh Almon, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi.
Hih khuapite khempeuh Aaron’ suanlekhak; Kohath mi, siampite aa ding hi a, khuapi sawm le thum leh a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh ahi hi.
Levi mite behte sung panin Kohath mi a omlaite in Ephraim minam tung panin sehtanh khuapite a ngah uh hi.
Amaute in Ephraim mualtungte a Shechem (hih pen mi thata a kingawh mi aa dingin bukna khuapi zong ahi hi), a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh, Gazer,
Kibzaim leh Beth Horon a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi;
Dan minam tung panin Kohath mi beh a omlaite ngah in: Eltekeh, Gibbethon,
Aiylon leh Gath Rimmon, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi.
Menasheh minam-alangte tung panin amaute ngah in: Taanach leh Gath Rimmon, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi nih ahi hi.
Hih khuapi sawm leh a neihkhop-gamte uh pen Kohath mi beh a omlaite tungah kipia hi.

Gershon’ suan Levi mi behte tunga a kipiate pen Menasheh adang minam-alangte kiang panin: Bashan-a Golan (hih pen mi thata kingawh mi aa dingin bukna khuapi khat ahi hi) leh Be Eshtarah, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi nih ahi hi.
Issachar minam tung panin amau ngahte in: Kishion, Daberath,
Yarmuth leh En Gannim, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi;
Asher minam tung panin Gershon mi behte ngahte in: Mishal, Abdon,
Helkath leh Rehob, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi;
Naphtali minam tung panin amau ngahte in: Galilee-a Kedesh (hih pen mi thata kingawh mi aa dingin bukna khuapi khat ahi hi), Hammoth Dor leh Kartan, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi thum ahi hi.
Gershon mi behte’ khuapi khempeuh pen sawm le thum hi a, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh ahi hi.
Levi mite beh a omlaite ahi Merari behte a kipiate in: Zebulun minam tung panin Yokneam, Kartah,
Dimnah leh Nahalal, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi;
Reuben minam tung panin Bezer, Yatzah,
Kedemoth leh Mephaath, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, khuapi li ahi hi;
Gad minam tung panin Gilead-a Ramoth (hih pen mi thata kingawh mi aa dingin bukna khuapi khat ahi hi), Mahanaim,
Heshbon leh Yazer, a neihkhop-gamte uh tawh hi a, a vekin khuapi li ahi hi.
Levi behte a omlai ahi Merari suan behte tungah sehtanh khuapi khempeuh pen sawm le nih ahi hi.
Israyl mite neih gam sunga Levi mite khuapi khempeuh pen khuapi 48 leh a neihkhop-gamte ciat tawh ahi hi.
Hih khuapite in a kiimkot ah neihkhop-gam a nei ciat uh hi. Hih khuapite khempeuh aa dingin a man mah ahi hi.
Hih bang danin Yahweh in a pu a pate uh tungah piak dingin a ciamsa gam khempeuh Israyl pia a, amaute in neih dingin la-in a sungah a teng uh hi.
Yahweh in a pu a pate uh tungah a ciamsa bang teekteekin a kiimkot panun gal a vengsak hi. A galte uh khat beek amau langah pang zo lo a, a galte khempeuh uh Yahweh in amaute khut ah a pia hi.
Yahweh in Israyl innkuan tungah a kamciam hoih khempeuh khat beek kipelh lo hi. A ciamna peuhpeuh a tangtung hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Reuben minam, Gad minam leh Menasheh minam-alangte sam a,
amaute kiangah, “Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in sep dingin note hong thupiakna khempeuh na semkhin uh a, sep dingin note kong thupiak khempeuh nong mangkhin uh hi.
Sawtpi-a kipan tuni mahmah dong na sanggamte uh na taisan ngei kei uh a, Yahweh note Pa in sep dinga hong thupiakna na zui uh hi.

Tu-in Amah in amaute tungah a ciamsa bang teekteekin Yahweh note Pa in na sanggamte tungah tawlngakna pia ta hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in Yardan pang langkhat lama note hong piakna gama na innlum uh ah ciah un;

Ahih hangin Yahweh nasempa Mosheh in note hong piak Thukham leh thupiakna ahi: Yahweh na Pa uh it ding, Ama lampi khempeuh tot ding, Ama Thukhamte zuih ding, Amah letkip ding leh na lungsim khempeuh na nuntakna khempeuh tawh Ama na na sep ding uh limtaka zuih ding na pilvang mahmah un,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in amaute thupha pia-in, galvai tavuan panin khakhia a, amaute a inn uh ah a ciah uh hi.

(Menasheh minam-alangte tungah Mosheh in Bashan ah leitang pia a, Menasheh adang minam-alangte tungah Yahshua in Yardan nitumna hih lampang ah a sanggamte tawh leitang a pia hi.) Yahshua in amaute inn ah a ciahsak taktak ciangin, amah in amaute thupha pia a,
“Na hauhna lianpi uh—ganhing hon tampitak, ngun, kham, sumngo leh sik tampitak leh puansilh tampitak tawh ciah un. Na galte uh van na lakte uh na sanggamte uh tawh hawm un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Reuben minam, Gad minam leh Menasheh minam-alangte’ Canaan gam Shiloh-a Israyl mite nusia uh a, Yahweh in Mosheh tungtawnin a thupiakna tawh kizui-in a neih uh, amau’ neihsa gam Gilead ah a ciahsan uh hi.
Canaan gama Yardan gamgite ah amaute a tun uh ciangin Reuben, Gad leh Menasheh minam-alangte in Yardan kiangah thupi-in a nak liat mahmah biaknatau khat a lam uh hi.
Israyl mite omna lampang Yardan gamgi, Canaan tawh gamgitna ah amaute in biaknatau a lamkhitna thu Israyl mite in a zak uh ciangin,
Amaute a do dingin Shiloh ah Israyl mihon buppi kikaikhawm uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin mite in Gilead gam-a Reuben, Gad leh Menasheh minam-alangte kiangah siampi Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas sawl uh hi.
Israyl minam innkuan panin ukpi khat ciat, ukpi sawm Phinehas tawh sawl uh hi. Khat ciat pen a pu a pate innkuan lutung pan ahi hi. Amaute pen Israyl beh tuamtuamte pan ahi uh hi.
Gilead-a Reuben, Gad leh Menasheh minam-alangte kiangah a tun uh ciangin, amaute kiangah:

“Hih in Yahweh’ mihon buppi hong gen ahi hi: Yahweh lehdona-in nomau aa dingin biaknatau lamna tawh Yahweh kiang panin pialin Israyl’ Pa tungah na khialh uh ahi hih na cihtak loh themthumna uh a bangci ahi hiam?
Yahweh’ mihonpi tungah pulnatna nangawn hong tun hangin, Peor-a i bawlsa mawhna hangin tuni mahmah dong i kisiansuah nai lohna ahi Peor-a mawhna eite aa dingin thuneu mahmah sa na hi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin tuni-in en un, Yahweh kiang panin na kihei uh hi! Tuni-in Yahweh na lehdo leh, zingciangin Israyl mihon buppi tungah Amah hong heh ding hi.

Na mat uh leitang leh na laksa uh tua leitang a siang lo ahih leh, Yahweh’ Puanbuk a dinna mun Yahweh matsa leitang ah hong pai unla, kote lakah luah hong nei un. Ahi zongin Yahweh i Pa biaknatau lo adang ahi a, a tuamin ahi zongin note aa dingin biaknatau lamna tawh Yahweh ahi a, kote ka hi uh zongin nong lehdo kei bek ding uh hi.

A ki-apsa vante ah Zerah’ tapa Achan gamta khial hilo ahi hiam? Amah pen mi khat bek hinapi-in Israyl mihon buppi tungah hehna hong om hi. Ama mawhna hangin amah bek in sihna thuak lo hi, ci hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Menasheh minam-alangte in dawngin, Israyl beh lutangte kiangah:

Vanglian Khat, Yahweh hi. Amah pen Pa ahi hi! Vanglian Khat, Yahweh, Amah pen Pa ahi hi. Amah in thei a, Israyl mahmah in zong thei tahen—Hih pen Yahweh tungah lehdona ahih keileh thumang lohna ahih leh, tuni-in kote hong hingkhawi kei un!

Kote in Yahweh zuihna panin pial theih nading ahih keileh tua biaknatau tungah meihal biaknate, an tawh biaknate, kilemna biaknate ka piak theih nadingun kote aa dingin biaknatau a dawh ka hih uh leh Yahweh mahmah in hong thuaksak hen.
Hun khat ciangin na suanlekhakte un ko suanlekhakte kiangah, ‘Note in Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh tawh bang kisaikhakna om ahi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ko leh no kikalah gamgi-in Yardan bawlkhinzo a, Reuben leh Gad mite in Yahweh tawh tanh nei lo hi,’ a cih khak ding uh launa hangin hih bangin a hih ka hi uh hi. Hih thu hangin, Yahweh zahtakna panin na suanlekhakte un ko suanlekhakte beisak kha ding hi.
Tua thu hangin kote in, ‘Tu-in kithawi ni, meihal biaknate ahih keileh biakpiaknate aa dingin biaknatau ahi lo biaknatau khat lam ni,’ ka cih uh ahi hi.

Tua hi lozaw-in ka meihal biaknate, biakpiaknate leh kilemna biaknate tawh Yahweh omna a munsiangtho ah Yahweh ka biak theih nadingun no leh ko leh ko khita ka suanlekhakte kikalah teci khat ahi hi.Tua ciangin mailam hun ah no suanlekhakte in ko suanlekhakte kiangah, ‘Yahweh sungah no sehtanh om lo hi,’ a ci thei kei ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin kote in, Amaute in eite leh i suanlekhakte tungah hih a cih khak uh leh: En un, ka pate’ dawhsa Yahweh’ biaknatau tawh a kibatpih lim ahi hi. Tua pen meihal biaknate leh biakpiaknate aa ding hi lo hi. Tua pen ko leh no kikal-a teci ding ahi hi, ci-in ka dawng ding uh hi.

Ama Puanbuk mai-a ding i Pa Yahweh’ biaknatau panin adang ahi a, a tuamin ahi zongin meihal biaknate, an tawh biaknate, biakpiaknate aa dingin biaknatau dawhna tawh tuni-in Yahweh zuihna panin a kihei, leh Yahweh lehdo ding ka hi hethet kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Siampi Phinehas leh Israyl beh lutangte ahi mihon makaite in Reuben, Gad leh Menasheh-te genna a zak uh ciangin, amaute a lungnuam uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin siampi Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas in Reuben, Gad leh Menasheh-te tungah, “Hih thu ah note Yahweh tungah a citak lo themthumin a gamta hilo na hih manun tuni-in eite lakah Yahweh hong omna thu i thei hi. Yahweh khut panin Israyl mite nong honkhia uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin Reuben mite, Gad mite leh Menasheh minam-alangte tawh kimuhna panin Canaan gam ah siampi Eleazar’ tapa Phinehas leh makaite a ciah uh hi. Amaute in Israyl mite kiangah a kammalte uh a puakkik hi.

Amaute in hih thupuakna a zak uh ciangin lungdam uh a, Yahweh a phat uh hi. Amaute in Reuben minam, Gad minam leh Menasheh minam-alangte’ tenna mun leitang suksiatgawp ding, amaute galin do-in a pai ding thu a gen nawn kei uh hi.
Reuben mite, Gad mite leh Menasheh minam-alangte in, “Yahweh pen i Pa taktak ahihna eite kikalah teci ahi hi,” ci-in a biaknatau uh min a pia hi.
Yahweh in amaute kiimkota om a galte khempeuh kiang panin Israyl mite tungah tawlngakna a piakkhit hun sawtpi ciangin Nun’ tapa Yahshua teekin a kum tampi pha ta a,
Yahshua in Israyl khempeuh—tua pen a upate, a ukpite, a thukhente, leh a uliante—sam a, amaute kiangah, “Ka teekta a, a kum a cing mahmah ta hi.
Yahweh pen i Pa taktak ahih manin eite hangin hih minamte khempeuh tungah Yahweh i Pa in a bawlna khempeuh na mukhin uh hi. Amah pen Khat hi a, eite aa dingin hong dosakpa ahi hi.

Yardan panin nitumna lama Tuipi Lian; Mediterranean Tuipi, ciang dong, a omlai minamte pen ka zawhsa minamte tawh na minamte uh gamh dingin note tungah ai-lotna tawh note tungah kong hawmsakkhitna thu phawk un.
Yahweh na Pa mahmah un na lampi uh panin amaute hawlkhia hi. Yahweh na Pa un hong ciamsa bangin Amah in na mai panun amaute nilkhia-in, note in amau’ gam neihsa-in na la ding uh hi.
Mosheh tungtawnin a kipia Thukham Laibu sunga kigelh khempeuh, veilam ahi a, taklam ahi zongin pial loin limtakin zui-in na hih ding uh nak pilvang mahmah un;

Note tawh a om lai minamte tawh kipawl kei un: amau pasiante’ minte lo kei unla biaknasep nadingin a minte tawh zong kiciam kei un. Tuate na nasem peuhmah kei ding uh a, tuate mai-ah zong na kun peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Tu donga na letkipsa uh bangin Yahweh na Pa uh na letkip ding uh ahi hi.
Yahweh in note mai-ah lianin a vanglian minamte hawlkhia khin hi. Note na hih uh leh tuni mahmah dongin kuamah in note langah hong pang zolo uh hi.
Amah hong ciamsa bangin note aa dingin hong dosakpa pen Yahweh ahih manin note khat in tul khat na taikeksak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Ama thu manna tawh Yahweh note Pa na it ding uh limtakin ngaihsun un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh note nungkikin note lakah a omlai minamte tawh kipawlin minam kibang loin kitengin na kithuah uh leh,

Yahweh na Pa un note’ mai-ah hih minamte hawlkhia nawn lo ding hi, cih teltakin thei un. Tua hi kei leh Yahweh note Pa in note hong piaksa hih gam hoih panin na manthan matengun note aa dingin amaute thang leh thangzak suak ding uh a, hong kisatna khauteep leh na mit uh hong sun ling suak ding hi.

Tu-in leitung dan nate khempeuh ngeina bangin a pai ding ka hi ta hi. Yahweh note Pa in hong piaksa a thupi kamciamte khat beek pelhem loin a veka hong piak lam na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na hinna bangbangun na thei zo uh hi. Eite aa dingin a vekpi-in hong tangtung hi. Kammal khat zong kipelh lo hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa un hong ciamsa a thupi na khempeuh eite aa dingin hong tangtun bang teekteekin Yahweh in hong piaksa hih gam hoih panin note hong siatsak matengin Yahweh in note tungah a sia nate zong tua mah bangin hong tun ding hi.

Amah in note hong thupiak Yahweh na Pa uh thuciamna na palsatin, pai-in pasiante’ na semin a mai-ah na kun uh ciangin Yahweh’ hehna note tungah hong kuang ding a, Amah in hong piaksa gam hoih panin note manlang takin hong mangthang ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in Shechem ah Israyl minam khempeuh kaikhawm hi. Amah in Israyl upate, makaite, thukhente leh uliante samin, amau mahmah Yahweh mai-ah a kipulaak uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in mi khempeuh tungah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh thugen hih bang ahi hi: Tanglai pekpekin na pu na pate, leh Abraham leh Nahor’ pa Terah mahmah zong Gun; Euphrates gun, gal ah tengin pasiante (elohim) bia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Gun; Euphrates gun, gal panin na pupi uh Abraham ka la hi. Canaan leitang khempeuh tawnin ka paisak kawikawi hi. Suanlekhak tampi amah ka pia a, Isaac zong amah ka pia hi.

Isaac tungah Yaaqob leh Esau ka pia hi. Esau tungah a luah dingin Seir mualtungte ka pia a, ahih hangin Yaaqob leh a tapate Egypt ah paisuk uh hi. Tua lai panin amaute minam lian, thahatin tampi hong hi uh a, Egypt mite in amaute a gawt uh hi.
Tua ciangin Keimah in Mosheh leh Aaron sawlin, tua muna ka hihsa limte tawh Egypt mite ka gawt a, tua khit ciangin amaute ka paikhiatpih hi.
Egypt panin na pu na pate uh ka paikhiatpih-in, tuipi na tun uh ciangin Egypt mite in sakol tung tuangte leh leengte tawh Tuipi San dong note hong nungdelh uh hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh tungah amaute kiko uh a, Amah in note leh Egypt mite kikalah khuamial a koih hi; Amah in amaute tungah tuipi tuumsakin amaute a tuamcipsak hi. Egypt ah ka bawlna na mit mahmah uh tawh na mu uh a, tua khit ciangin sehnel gam ah tawl khat sung na teng uh hi.

Yardan pang langkhat lama teng Amor mite gam ah note kong paipih a, amaute in note hong do uh hi. Note vangliatna sungah amaute ka koih a, amau’ gam luahna na la uh hi. Note mai panin amaute ka susia hi.
Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak in Israyl do dingin kithawi a, note tungah samsiatna hong koih dingin Beor’ tapa Balaam a sawl hi.
Ahih hangin Keimah in Balaam’ thu ngai lo ka hih manin amah in note thupha hong pia phapha hi. Ama vangliatna panin note kong honkhia hi.

Tua khit ciangin note in Yardan kantanin Yericho ah na tung uh hi. Amor mite, Periz mite, Canaan mite, Hit mite, Girgash mite, Hiv mite leh Yebus mite in hong do bangin Yericho mite in note hong do uh a, ahih hangin note vangliatna sungah amaute kong pia hi.
Note mai-ah tunpi* ka sawl a, note mai panin Amor mi kumpi nih a hawlkhia hi; Na namsau uh tawh ahi a, na thal uh tawh ahi zongin na hih uh ahi kei hi.
Tua bangin no gimna loin gam kong pia a, no lam lohin khuapite kong pia hi; tuate ah na teng uh hi. Na suan loh uh leengguite leh olive kungte panin na ne uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in Yahweh zahtak unla diktatna leh thuman takin Ama na sem unla, Euphrates Gun gal leh Egypt-a na pu na pate uh biak pasiante paimangin Yahweh’ na sem un!

Ahih hangin Yahweh’ na na sep ding uh a sia tawh a kibang nasak uh leh, tuni-in nomau mah in kua’ na sem ding cih teel un—Gun; Euphrates gun, gal-a na pu na pate pasiante’ na ahi a, tu-in na tenna uh Amor mite pasiante’ na ahi zongin teel un; Ahi zongin Kei leh Ka innkuanpihte in Yahweh’ na ka sem ding uh hi!’ a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite in dawngin, “Yahweh nusia-in a kikham pasiante’ na ka sep ding uh kote tawh kigamla mahmah hi!

Saltanna gam Egypt panin eite leh i pute hong paikhiatpih a, eite mitmuhin lim lianpite a bawl pen Yahweh i Pa mahmah ahi hi. I khualzinna bupi leh minamte khempeuh laka i zinna ah Amah in eite hong dal hi.
Tua hi a eite mai-ah minamte khempeuh, hih gama teng Amor mite zong Yahweh in hawlkhia hi. Kote in zong Yahweh’ na ka sem ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah pen ka Pa uh ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.

Yahshua in mite kiangah, “Note in Yahweh’ na na sem thei kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah pen a siangtho Pa ahi hi! Amah pen a haza thei Pa ahi hi. Amah in na lehdona uh leh na mawhnate uh hong maisak lo ding hi.

Yahweh na nusia-in pasiante’ na nasem uh leh, Amah in note hong kiimkotin hong nasak ding hi. note tungah a hoih hong bawl khit ciangin Amah in note tungah natna hong puak ding a, note hong beisak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in Yahshua kiangah, “Hi peuhmah kei! Yahweh’ na ka sem ding uh hi!,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshua in mite kiangah, “Yahweh zahtak ding—tua pen Yahweh’ na sep ding, na teel uh no le no teci na hi uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Tecite ka hi uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Nun’ tapa Yahshua in, “Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, note laka pasiante (elohim) paaikhia unla, Israyl’ Pa Yahweh lam ah na lungsim uh ap un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite in Yahshua kiangah, “Yahweh i Pa’ na ka sem ding uh a, Ama thu ka mang ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin Yahshua in Yahweh’ Thukham Laibu sungah hih kammalte a gelh hi. Amah in suangtum lian khat la-in, Yahweh’ munsiangtho kianga om tawsaw kung nuai-ah a phut hi. Note in Yahweh nialin khem a, Ama tungah na man kei uh leh tua pen note langah teci hi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahshua in kikhensakin amau gamh ciat ah a ciahsak hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Nun’ tapa, Yahweh na sempa Yahshua kum 110 a phakin si hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in Gaash Mual leilu lam, Ephraim mualtung gam Timnath Serah-a ama gamh luahna leitang ah a vui uh hi. Yahweh in amaute a thupiakna bangin Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih lai-in Israyl’ suante amah in vun a atna meisuang temte, amah a vuina hankhuk sungah Israyl mite in amah tawh koih khawm hi. Tua lai ah tuni dongin tuate om lai hi.
Yahshua nuntak sung tawntungin leh Yahweh in Israyl aa dingin a bawlna khempeuh a mu amah sanga sawt a nungtazaw upate nuntak hun sung teng Israyl-te in Yahweh’ na sem uh hi.
Egypt panin Israyl mite in a puaktoh uh Yahseph’ guhte pen Shechem’ pa Hamor’ tapate tung panin Yaaqob in nguntang zakhat-a a leina leikhawk ah vui a, Yahseph mite guahluah a suak hi.

Aaron’ tapa Eleazar si a, a tapa Phinehas tungah sehtanhna ahi Ephraim mualtung gam sunga Gibeah ah kivui hi. Tua hun lai-in Israyl mite in amau laka khualzinna ah Yahweh’ singkuang pua uh a, amah si-in Gibeah ah a kivui matengin Phinehas pen a pa Eleazar munah siampi-in om hi. Tua ciangin Israyl mite, amau khuapi ciata munsiangtho ciatah a pai uh hi. Israyl mite in Astarte (Ashtaroth, Easter) leh amau kiimkota minamte pasiante (elohim) bia uh hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh in Moab kumpipa Eglon’ vangliatna sungah amaute pia a, amaute kum sawm le kum giat sung a nengniam hi.
